sa: गच्छन्नेव तु कौन्तेयो धर्मराजदिदृक्षया। सैन्यमालोकयामास नापश्यत् तत्रचाग्रजम्॥ युद्धं कृत्वा तु कौन्तेयो द्रोणपुत्रेण भारत। दुःसह वज्रिणा संख्ये पराजित्य गुरोः सुतम्॥
en: O Bharata! Arjuna, the son of Kunti subsequent to the bitter defeat he gave to the son of preceptor, (Ashvatthama) tough to face for Indra, the holder of thunderbolt, threw a cursory eye on the whole army while he was leaving from there to see Dharmaraja. However, he could not see his elder brother there.

sa: सराक्षसगणा राजन् सकिन्नरमहोरगा। जङ्गमाः स्थावराः सर्वे नालं पार्थस्य संयुगे॥
en: And the Rakshasas, the Kinnaras and the reptiles, O king, in fact, with all the mobile and immobile creatures, cannot withstand Pritha's son Arjuna in battle.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम सूतपुत्रस्य लाघवम्। यदेनं सर्वतो यत्ता नाप्नुवन्ति परे युधि॥
en: There we beheld of wonderful lighthandness of the charioteer's son : for, all the hostile forces, exerting their utmost, could not subdue him in that battle.

sa: कृतित्वे बाहुवीर्य च तथैवासम्भ्रमेऽपि च। शीघ्रतामोधबुद्धित्वे नास्ति पार्थसमः क्वचित्॥
en: Nobody anywhere is comparable to Arjuna, the son of Kunti in respect of his knowledge in weaponry, physical stamina, smartness and target hitting savvy etc. qualities.

sa: शरान् पञ्चाशतस्तांस्तु शैनेयः कृतहस्तवत्। चिच्छेद समरे राजन् प्रेषितांस्तनयेन ते॥
en: Then like one endued with great lightness of hands, Shinis' grandson, O king, cut-off the group of fifty arrows shot by your son in that battle.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्ततः कर्णमविध्यद् दशभिः शरैः॥ द्रौपदेयास्त्रिसप्तत्या युयुधान्स्तु सप्तभिः। भीमसेनश्शुतःषष्ट्या सहदेव सप्तभिः॥ नकुलस्त्रिंशता बाणैः शतानीकस्तु सप्तभि। शिखण्डी दशभिर्वीरो धर्मराजः शतेन तु॥
en: Then Dhristadyumna pierced Karna with ten arrows, the sons of Draupadi pierced him with sevenly three arrows and Satyaki with seven. Bhimasena pierced him with sixty four arrows and Sahadeva with seven. Nakula pierced him with thirty arrows and Shatanika with seven. The heroic Shikhandin pierced him with ten and king Yudhishthira with a hundred.

sa: गोवर्धनो नाम वटः सुभद्रं नाम चत्वरम्। एतद् राजकुलद्वारमाकुमारात् स्मराम्यहम्॥
en: I remember from my youth that a slaughter ground for kine and the cellars for wine mark out the gates of the palaces of Balhika kings.

sa: ततोऽस्य सारथिं क्षिप्रमन्यं दुर्योधनोऽदिशत्। स तेन संगृहीताश्वः पुनरभ्यद्रवद् रिपून्॥
en: Duryodhana then quickly ordered charioteer (to guide Drona's car). The reins of the) horses being taken by him, he (i.c., Drona) again proceeded against his foes.

sa: अन्तकप्रतिमो वेगे शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः। असौ गच्छति कौरव्य द्रौणिः शस्त्रभूतां वरः॥
en: O son of Kuru! The best weaponist Ashvatthama is also marching towards them. He is forceful as Yamaraja and valorous as Indra, the king of gods.

sa: दुर्योधन कर्णस्य भोजस्य कृतवर्मणः। मद्रराजस्य शल्यस्य द्रौणेश्चैव कृपस्य च ॥ मत्पुत्रस्य च शेषस्य तथाऽन्येषां च संजय। विप्रद्रुतेष्वनीकेषु मुखवर्णोऽभवत् कथम्॥
en: O Sanjaya, when my troops had run away (from the battle field), what had become the colour of the faces of Duryodhana, Karna, Kritavarman the ruler of the Bhojas, Shalya the king of the Madras, Ashvatthaman the son of Drona and Kripacharya, as well as of the remaining sons of mine and several other monarchs.

sa: परिवब्रुस्ततः सर्वे पाण्डवस्य महारथम्॥ निगृह्य तं प्रचुक्रुशुर्वध्यामानां शितैः शरैः।
en: They, then, all surrounded the huge car of Pandava. And then assailing him with sharpened arrows they, desirous of killing him, began to emit terrific cries.

sa: पार्थेनैकेन निहताः सिंहेनेवेतरे मृगाः। मम व्यायच्छमानस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: Destroyed by Partha alone like numerous inferior beasts slain by a lion, even when the high-minded Drona and myself were fighting (in order to resist Arjuna).

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो हयान् हत्वा सर्वांस्तस्य महात्मनः। चकार समरे भूमि शोणितौघतरङ्गिणीम्ः॥
en: Thereupon killing all the horses of the highsouled one Arjuna created, in the battle-field, a dreadful stream of blood, carrying away all to the other region.

sa: तानेवं ब्रुवतो वीरान् सात्यकिनिशितैः शरैः। जधान त्रिशतानश्वान् कुञ्जरांश्च चतुःशतान्॥
en: Satyaki then fell to slaughter those heroes even when they were thus speaking, with his sharp arrows. He slew three hundred steeds and four hundred elephants.

sa: एवं तु त्रिपुरं दग्धं दानवाश्चाप्यशेषतः माहेश्वरेण क्रुद्धेन त्रैलोक्यस्य हितैषिणा॥
en: Thus three cities were burnt and the Danavas were all destroyed by wrathful Maheshvara, who had wrought it having the desire for benefiting the three worlds.

sa: निहत्य तान् बाणगणैोणो राजन् समन्ततः। महाजलधरान् व्योम्नि मातरिश्वेव चावभौ॥
en: Then baffling those thick showers of arrows by means of his own, like the wind scattering away mighty rain-clouds on the sky, Drona appeared exceedingly beautiful.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन परिघं घोरदर्शनम्। द्विधा चिच्छेद समरे प्रहसन्निव कौरवः॥
en: (But the descendant of Kuru), as if with a smile, cut-off into two parts, in that engagement, that dreadful-looking Parigha so it was advancing against him.

sa: तं तु सायकमायान्तमाचार्यस्य रथं प्रति। कर्णो द्वादशधा राजंश्चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत्॥
en: Then as that shaft coursed towards the chariot of Drona, Oking Karna like one endued with great lightness of hands, cut it off into twelve fragments.

sa: पूजितो धृतराष्ट्रेण सपुत्रेण महाबलः। त्वदर्थमेव राधेयः स कथं निहतस्त्वया॥
en: O prince, he was respected by Dhritarashtra himself as well as by his sons for you alone. How has then of Radha been killed by today?

sa: उदीची दक्षिणां प्राची प्रतीची विदिशस्तथा। नृत्यन्त्रिवाचरच्छूरो यथा रथशतं तथा॥
en: Then if dancing and resembling, although alone, a hundred car-warriors, that hero careered in the East, West, North and South and all the subsidiary directions. as

sa: निमज्जमानमुद्धत्य कश्चिद् राजा निशाचरम्। अपृच्छत् तेन चाख्यातं प्रोक्तवांस्तन्निबोध मे॥
en: While going down the stream a king rescued the Rakshasa. Asked by the former the latter gave this answer. I will recite it to you, listen.

sa: जलसन्धं हतं दृष्ट्वा वृष्णीनामृषभेण तु। विमुखाश्चाभ्यधावन्त तव योधाः समन्ततः॥
en: At the sight of Jalasandha slain by that foremost pf the Vrishnis. Your troops then turning away their faces began to fly away in all directions.

sa: ततः कृष्णो महाबाहु रजतप्रतिमान् हयान्। हयज्ञश्चोदयामास जयद्रथवधं प्रति॥ तं प्रयान्तममोघेषुमुत्पतद्भिरिवाशुगैः। त्वरमाणा महाराज सेनामुख्या: समाद्रवन्॥ दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च वृषसेनोऽथ मद्रराट्।
en: Then the mighty-armed Krishna versed in horse-lore, urged those horses of Argentine hue towards the car of Jayadratha. Then as Arjuna proceeded shooting swift-flying arrows ever hitting their marks. O mighty monarch, the foremost warriors of yours troops quickly proceeded to meet him. They Duryodhana, Karna, Vrishasena, the king of the Madras.

sa: तेनैवमभ्यतिक्रान्तः श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः। तस्य दोषं न पश्यामि द्रोणस्यानेन हेतुना॥
en: It was on this account, that Setasva with Krishna as his charioteer was able to overcome him. I cannot, therefore, find any fault in Drona. are

sa: तया तु वीरघातिन्या शक्त्या त्वभिहतो भृशम्। निर्भिन्नहृदयस्तूर्णं निपपात रथान्महीम्॥
en: Wounded sore with that lance capable of killing all creatures, the latter with his heart rent open, quickly fell down on the Earth from his car.

sa: उत्सृज्य कवचानन्ये प्राद्रवंस्तावका विभो। अन्योन्यं ते समाक्रोशन सैनिका भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Others among your troops fled, O lord, throwing off their coats of mail. O foremost of the Bharatas, then your troops addressing one another loudly said

sa: तौ चाप्यहं शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठौ व्यपेतभीर्योधयिष्यामि कृष्णौ। च्छापोऽद्य मां ब्राह्मणसत्तमाच॥
en: I shall fearlessly fight with those two Krishnas, the foremost of the wielders of weapons. The course of Rama, the foremost of Brahmanas, pains me greatly.

sa: निरुद्धाश्च वयं सर्वे सैन्धवेन दुरात्मना। निमित्तमभवद् द्रोणः सपुत्रस्तत्र कर्मणि॥
en: We also were held in check by the highsouled ruler of the Sindhus ; in the perpetration of that deed, Drona and Drona's son became instrumental.

sa: ते वध्यमाना भीमेन राक्षसाः क्रूरबुद्धयः। विनेदुस्तुमुलान्नादान् दुद्रुवुस्ते दिशो दश॥
en: Those Rakshasas, of cruel minds, when thus engaged with Bhima, began to utter loud roared and to run in all the ten directions of the compass.

sa: न तु तन्ममृषे कर्णो धनुषश्छेदनं तथा। निकर्तनमिवात्युग्रं लाङ्गलस्य महाहरिः॥
en: Thereafter the heroic Dhristadyumna piercing his opponent warriors with wellshaprened shafts cut-off with broad-headed arrows, the bow of Radha's son versed in various modes of war-fare.

sa: एवमादि मयान्यैर्वा शक्यं वक्तुं भवेद् बाहु॥ आकेशाग्रान्नखाग्राच वक्तव्येषु कुकर्मसु।
en: These and such like many other things of their evil acts beginning with the tip of their hair to that of their nails I can recount.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि भीमेन कुञ्जरानीकमाहवे॥ विशीर्णदन्तं निहतं तदा नैवं वदिष्यसि।
en: When you will see Bhimsena killed elephants with their riders by serially splitting their teeth in the battle-field, your tongue will dcfinitely pause saying anything otherwise,

sa: स रथस्तव पुत्रस्य त्वरया परया युतः॥ तूर्णमभ्यद्रवद् द्रोणं मनोमारुतवेगवान्।
en: On a single car and in all haste and reflecting on the various measures to be adopted. That chariot of your son driven with great celerity.

sa: मत्स्याविव महाजालं विदार्य विगतक्लमौ। तथा कृष्णावदृश्येतां सेनाजालं विदार्य तत्॥
en: They then with their fatigue completely dispelled and passing beyond that net-work of soldiers, looked like two fishes that had torn away from a strong net.

sa: स्था रथैर्विमथिता मत्ता मत्तैर्द्विपा द्विपैः। सादिनः सादिभिश्चैव तस्मिन् परमसंकुले॥
en: In that formidable battle, the cars were smitten by cars, the infuriate elephants were crushed by infuriate elephants and the horsemen were struck down by horse-men.

sa: एते ह्यभिमुखाः सर्वे राधेयेन युयुत्सवः। आयान्ति पाण्डवा ब्रह्मन्नाह्वयन्तः समन्ततः॥
en: O Brahmana, all the Pandavas, desiring to fight with and shouting to the son of Radha (to give battle) are coming (against him) from all sides.

sa: मया वध्योऽभविष्यत् स भैमसेनिर्घटोत्कचः। मया न निहतः पूर्वमेष युष्पत्प्रियेप्सया॥
en: Then it would have been my (painful) duty to slay Bhimasena's son Ghatotkacha. It was only for pleasing you that I did not slay him before.

sa: ध्वजाः शिरांसि छत्राणि द्विपहस्ता नृणां भुजाः। क्षुरैर्भल्लार्धचन्द्रश्च च्छिन्ना: पेतुर्महीतले॥
en: The standards, heads, umbrellas, trunks of elephants and arms of men, being severed by the razor-like, broad headed and crescentshaped arrows, fell down upon the earth.

sa: तं निहत्य प्रलुब्धोऽयं शिखण्डी पूर्णमानसः। पाञ्चाल्यैः सहितः सर्वैः सेनाग्रमभिवर्तते॥
en: The covetous Shiknandi, having killed him, has got his desire fulfilled and is (now) stationed at the head of his troops together with all the Panchalas.

sa: व्यदीप्यन्त दिशः सर्वाः प्रदीपैस्तैः समन्ततः। वर्षाप्रदोषे खद्योतैर्वृता वृक्षा इवाबभुः॥
en: All the points illuminated by the light of) those lamps all around, looked (beautiful) like trees teeming with glow-worms on an evening of the rainy season.

sa: भीमसेनस्तथा द्रौणिं कुर्वाणं कर्म दुष्करम्। विन्दानुविन्दौ कैकेयौ सात्यकिः समवारयत्॥
en: Then Bhimasena checked the progress of Drona's son, who was achieving the most arduous tasks and Satyaki, that of the two Kaikeya princes, Vindu and Anuvindu.

sa: दुःशासनश्च निशां तां तु दुर्योधननिवेशने। चिन्तयन्तः परिक्लेशान् पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: And they passed together that night in the abode of Duryodhana, whilst they were seriously thinking of the grief's with which the lofty-minded Pandavas were afflicted.

sa: जनाश्च तद् ददृशिरे रक्षः कौतूहलान्विताः। यदृच्छया निपतितं भूमावङ्गारकं यथा॥
en: Filled with curiosity, people then came to seen that Rakshasa who was lying on the field like a piece of charcoal (no longer capable of burning).

sa: सा छिन्ना बहुभिर्बाणैर्धारद्वाजेन मारिष। गदा पपात कौरव्य नादयन्ती धरातलम्॥
en: Cut off by numerous shafts by the son of Bharadvaja that mace, O sire, fell down, ) Kaurava, filling the earth with the noise it created.

sa: कृतास्त्रा रणदीक्षाभिर्दीक्षिता रणशालिनः। रणे जयं प्रार्थयाना भृशं युयुधिरे तदा॥
en: Accomplished in the use of weapons, skilled in fighting and firmly resolved to fight, warriors exerted themselves vigorously in the battle, desirous of winning fame only.

sa: वीरबाहुविमृष्टाश्च योधेषु च गजेषु च। राशयः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त वाससां नेजनेष्विव॥
en: Swords, hurled by the hands of heroic warriors upon combatants and elephants, in large heaps, were seen on the field, like cloths on the washing ground.

sa: लयमास्थाय राधेयो भीमसेनमवञ्चयत्। तं च दृष्ट्वा रथोपस्थे निलीनं व्यथितेन्द्रियम्॥
en: The son of Radha deceived Bhimasena by hiding himself inside his chariot. Beholding Karna hide himself in the terrace of his car with a frightened heart.

sa: अन्यांश्चस्मै रथोदारानुपास्थापयदच्युतः। अमोघां तां कथं शक्तिं मोघां कुर्यामिति प्रभो॥
en: That undeteriorating one even made other foremost of car-ivarriors confront Karna, thinking how that fatal Sakti of ours might be rendered futile by us, O master.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं पुनरेव विशाम्पते। लोके लोकविनाशाय परं लोकमभीप्सताम्॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, once more the battle between men desirous of getting heaven raged, a battle that was destructive of the world of creatures.

sa: तमभ्यधावद् द्विरदं भीमो भीमस्य नागराट्। महावातेरितं मेघं वातोद्भूत इवाम्बुदः॥
en: The most formidable and royal elephant of Bhima rapidly followed that elephant of (Kshemadhurti), even as the wind-blown cloud pursues the cloud dispersed by the tempest.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं पुनरेव विशाम्पते। लोके लोकविनाशाय परं लोकमभीप्सताम्॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, once more the battle between men desirous of getting heaven raged, a battle that was destructive of the world of creatures.

sa: भारद्वाजो महातेजा विव्याध च युधिष्ठिरम्। सात्यकिं दशभिर्बाणैविंशत्या पार्षतं शरैः॥
en: The highly-energetic son of Bharadvaja pierced Yudhishthira also. (Drona then struck) Satyaki with ten darts and the son of Prishata (i.e. Dhristadyumna) with twenty five darts.

sa: तं पृष्ठतोऽभ्ययात् तूर्णं शैनेयो वितुदञ्छरैः॥ वारणं जघनोपान्ते विषाणाभ्यामिव द्विपः।
en: And the son of Sini speedily pursued him striking him with arrows as an elephant pursues his rival piercing him with his tusks on the rear.

sa: ततः शरशतेनैव युयुधानो महारथः। अविध्यद् ब्राह्मणं संख्ये दृष्टरूपो विशाम्पते॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, with a cheerful appearance, the mighty car-warrior Yuyudhana, pierced in that that battle that Brahmana with a set of hundred arrows.

sa: अथान्ये धनुषी राजन् प्रगृह्य समरे तदा। पाण्डवं भृशसंक्रुद्धावर्दयामासतुः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon, Oking, taking another two bows and excited to the highest pitch of fury, they began to afflict sorely the son of Pandu, with their arrows.

sa: विक्रान्ताश्चापि शूराश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति च। कृतयत्ना विपन्नाश्च जीवयैतान्पुरंदर।७।।
en: O Purandara, do you revive all these heroic and powerful (monkeys) who did not care for death, and who worked hard and were distressed (for me).

sa: श्रुत्वैव तु महावीर्यो लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिद्वधम्। प्रहर्षमतुल लेभे वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: As soon as that exceedingly powerful one heard of the destruction of Indrajit by Lakşmana, he experienced a huge accession of joy, and thus delivered himself.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं तं शूरमङ्गदं कनकाङ्गदम्। द्रवमाणास्ततो वाक्यमूचुः शूरविगर्हितम् ॥
en: As Angada decked in golden angadas was saying this, the monkeys, flying away spoke to that hero words not worthy of being spoken to an hero.

sa: हनुमानपि विक्रान्तः सर्वं शुश्राव तत्त्वतः। सीतायास्त्रिजटायाश्च राक्षसीनां च तर्जितम्॥
en: And the powerful Hanumān, heard from the beginning to the end (the bewailings) of Sitā, the story to Trijatā's dream and the threats of the Rākşasīs.

sa: वचो मिथ्याप्रणीतात्मा पथ्यमुक्तं विचक्षणैः। राक्षसानामभावाय त्वं वा न प्रतिपद्यसे॥
en: Or the considerate people have spoken the truth, but you, for the destruction of the race of the Raksasas, considering that false, had not followed it.

sa: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठो बलवान् सत्त्ववानपि। किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षःसु न योजयसि राघव॥
en: O Rāghava, being thus the foremost of those acquainted with weapons, powerful, and possessed of strength, wherefore do you not direct your weapon against the Rākşasas'?

sa: सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद्ब्रतं मम॥
en: I always declare 'no fear' to all creatures, whenever any, approaching me, says, 'I am thine' and seek my shelter. Even this is my pious observance.

sa: भ्रमन्ता काञ्चनी कोटिं कार्मुकस्य महात्मनः। अलातचक्रप्रतिमां ददृशुस्ते न राघवम्॥
en: They at times saw the quick-moving golden end of the bow of that high-souled one, resembling a circular fire brand but they did not behold Rāghava.

sa: अहत्वा रावणं संख्ये सपुत्रजनबान्धवम्। अयोध्यां न प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्रिभिस्तैर्धातृभिः शपे॥
en: I do swear by my three brethren that I shall enter the city of Ayodhyā, after slaying in battle Ravana with his sons, kinsmen and friends.

sa: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्मथितसारथिः। अथ शक्तिं महातेजाः पितृव्याय मुमोच ह।॥
en: Then jumping down from his chariot with its horses slain, (Indrajit), endowed with great cnergy, who had his charioteer pounded, discharged a dart at his uncle.

sa: अबद्धा सागरे सेतुं घोरेऽस्मिन्वरुणालये। लङ्का नासादितुं शक्या सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: Without constructing a bridge over the deep, the terrible abode of Varuņa, even the celestials and their lord (India) cannot get at the city of Lanka.

sa: किमयं वानरो राजन् वनपः प्रत्युपस्थितः। किं चार्थमभिनिर्दिश्य दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: O king, why has this monkey, the guard over the forest, come to you, and what sorrow has led him to give vent to these expressions?

sa: कथं स्वपिति नागर्ति किमद्य च करिष्यति। विज्ञाय निपुणं सर्वमागन्तव्यमशेषतः॥
en: How he sleep and how he wake, and what he engage himself in, having deftly acquainted yourselves with all this thoroughly, do you come (back here).

sa: उपालम्भं न शक्ष्यामि सोढुमम्बासुमित्रया। इहैव देहं त्यक्ष्यामि नहि जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: I shall not be able to bear the rebuke of mother Sumitră. Therefore even here shall I renounce my person; for certainly I dare not live.

sa: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे राघवं गमनोत्सुकाः। पूजितास्ते च रामेण जग्मुर्देशान्स्वकान्स्वकान्॥
en: Thereupon the kings, highly delighted and desirous of going, bade farewell to Rāma, with folded palms and being honoured by him, left for their respective kingdoms.

sa: तस्य वेगेन तत्रासीत्तेजः प्रज्वलितं महत्॥ वज्रनिष्पेषसंजाता ज्वाला मेरोर्यथा गिरेः॥
en: The vehemence (of the blow) caused a great fire to blaze up at that spot, even as the thunderbolt smiting the mountain Meru, make place blazed.

sa: तेषां वरुणसूनूनां हत्वा योधान्हयांश्च तान्। मुमोचाशु महानादं विरथान्प्रेक्ष्य तान्स्थितान्॥
en: Having slain those warriors and also those horses of Varuna's sons (Mahodara) seeing them lying down deprived of their cars swiftly sent up a tremendous cheer.

sa: यन्निमित्तोऽयमारम्भः कर्मणां यः फलोदयः। तां देवीं शोकसंतप्तां द्रष्टुमर्हसि मैथिलीम्॥
en: It behove you now to see Maithili, stricken with grief for whom you did initiate all these works and the fruit whereof has now been attained.

sa: तथोक्तो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रतिगृह्य पितुर्वचः। यज्ञभूमौ स विधिवत्पावकं जुहवेन्द्रजित् ॥
en: Being thus addressed by the lord of the Raks asas and obeying his father's command, Indrajit proceeded towards the sacrificial ground to satisfy Fire (with oblations).

sa: दशग्रीवो रथस्थस्तु रामं वज्रोपमैः शरैः।। आजघान महाशैलं धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥
en: Even as a mass of clouds poured down torrents on a mighty mountain, the Ten-necked one, mounted on his car, smote Rāma with shafts resembling thunder-bolts.

sa: व्रणैः समुत्थैः शोभेतां पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ। युध्यमानौ परिश्रान्तौ जानुभ्यामवनीं गतौ॥
en: And with blooding flowing from their wounds, they looked beautiful like blossoming Kinsukas. And warring, both, overcome with fatigue, went to the ground on their knees.

sa: बद्ध्वा ह्येते दुरात्मानो नृपाज्ञापरिपन्थिनः। अमर्षप्रभवो रोषः सफलो मे भविष्यति॥
en: Those vicious-souled ones are worthy of being slain since they have transgressed the royal mandate. And then shall my wrath, arising out of impatience, bear fruits.

sa: हनूमांस्तु समुत्पत्य हयं त्रिशिरसस्तदा। विददार नखैः क्रुद्धो नागेन्द्रं मृगराडिव॥
en: Then Hanumān flying into a fury, bounding to the welkin, with his nails ript the steed of Triớiras, even as a lion cleave a powerful elephant.

sa: तस्य दुर्बुद्धिता राजंस्तव विप्रियकारिणः। वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथासौ न पुनव्रजेत्॥
en: O king, he has been impelled by his vicious sense, to do they mischief. Do you order for his head so that he might not return.

sa: एवमुक्तो गृहीत्वा तु तद्वचः पितृगौरवात्। सदारपुत्रः सामात्यः सवाहनधनो गतः॥
en: Thus addressed, Vaisravana, for the sake of his father's dignity, with his wives and sons, with his counsellors and his vehicles and wealth went (to Kailasa).

sa: इष्टं मधुवनं ह्येतत् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। पितृपैतामहं दिव्यं देवैरापि दुरासदम्॥
en: The picturesque Madhuvana is the most favourite orchard of the high-souled Sugrīva. It was enjoyed by his forefathers and is not even approached by the celestials.

sa: देवगन्धर्वकन्याभिर्यक्षकन्याभिरेव च। सार्धं प्रभो रमस्वेति सीतया किं करिष्यसि ॥
en: And, O lord, do you sport with the daughters of celestials and Gandharvas, and with the daughters themselves of Yakşas. What will you do with Sītā?

sa: ये ये महाबलाः सन्ति लघवश्च प्लवंगमाः। लङ्कामभिपतन्त्वाशु गृह्योल्काः प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: Now let those principal monkeys that are endowed with great strength and that are furnished with fleetness, taking fire-brands (in their hands) rapidly rush towards Lankā.

sa: इत्युक्तो लोकपालैस्तैः स्वामी लोकस्य राघवः। अब्रवीद् विदशश्रेष्ठानरामो धर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Being thus addressed by the deities presiding over quarters, Rāghava, the lord of people and the foremost of the pious, spoke to those leading celestials, saying.

sa: दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता। यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति॥
en: O Vaidehi, may good betide you; sprinkled with celestial paste and adorned with celestials ornaments do you ascend this car: your husband wish to see you.

sa: तदस्माकं हितार्थाय जहि तांश्च त्रिलोचन। राक्षसान्हंकृतेनैव दह प्रदहतां वर॥
en: Therefore, to do us good, do you, O threeeyed one, destroy them; and, O best of consuming ones, do you with your roars, burn them up.

sa: जनन्या राक्षसेन्द्रो वै त्वन्मोक्षार्थं बृहद्वचः। अतिस्निग्धेन वैदेहि मन्त्रिवृद्धेन चोदितः॥
en: O Vaidehi, the Rākşasa lord was advised by his mother and the aged counsellors in pregnant words informed with affection, having your deliverance for their object.

sa: एकस्यैवाभियाने तु हेतुर्यः प्राहतस्त्वया। तत्राप्यनुपपन्नं ते वक्ष्यामि यदसाधु च॥
en: Did you show the reasons for your taking the field alone? But I shall point you out what is improper and unreasonable in this (proposed) course.

sa: तद् भवान् दृष्टधर्मार्थस्तपः कृतपरिग्रहः। परदारान् महाप्राज्ञ नोपरोद्धं त्वमर्हसि ॥
en: You are cognisant of righteousness and interest, and had attained prosperity through your asceticism. Therefore, O eminently wise one, you ought not to confine another's wife.

sa: यत् त्वशक्यं बलवता कर्तुं प्राकृतबुद्धिना। अनुपासितवृद्धेन कः कुर्यात्तादृशं नरः॥
en: But what person ever act according to what is proposed feebly by one having strength, yet of inferior intelligence, and who has never respected the aged.

sa: त्यज राजन्निमं शोकं मिथ्या संतापमागतम्। यदियं त्यज्यतां चिन्ता शत्रुहर्षविवर्धिनी॥
en: It this anxiety of your conduce to the joy of the enemy, do you cast it off. and, O hero, bestir yourself, and summon up spirits.

sa: अनन्तभोगेन सहस्रमूर्धा नागेन भीमेन महाबलेन। बलात्परिक्षिप्तमिमं भवन्तो राजानमुत्क्षिप्य विमोचयन्तु॥
en: Do you take out and deliver the monarch, who has through force become subject to a dreadful and mighty, and thousand-headed serpent bursting with immeasurable prowess.

sa: गवयेन गवाक्षेण शरभेण गजेन च। अन्यैश्च हरिभियुद्धं दुर्धरं त्यक्तजीवितैः॥
en: Gavaya, and Gavākşa, and Sarabha, and Gaja, and other monkeys have faught as others are incapable of fighting, determined to lay down their lives (for me).

sa: चतुर्णामेव हि गतिर्वानराणां तरस्विनाम्। वालिपुत्रस्य नीलस्य मम राज्ञश्च धीमतः॥
en: Of all the monkeys, four only endowed with (exceptional) celerity, viz., Vāli's son, Nīla, the intelligent king, and myself, heave the power to come over here.

sa: स वानरानिमान् सर्वान् मधुलुब्धान् गतायुषः। घातयिष्यति दण्डेन सुग्रीवः ससुहृज्जनान्॥
en: And meting out punishment to these monkeys, eager to drink honey and almost half dead, Sugrīva shall slay them as will as their friends and relatives.

sa: ततो दानवदर्पघ्नं सौमित्रिं देवकण्टकः। तं पीडयित्वा बाहुभ्यां न प्रभुर्लङ्घनेऽभवत्॥
en: Then pressing hard Sumitrā's son-that humbler of the hauteur of the Daityas, that thorn in the sides of the celestials-could not move him (from his place).

sa: सह शूरैर्हरिगणैर्लब्धसंज्ञावरिंदमौ गच्छ त्वं भ्रातरौ गृह्य किष्किन्धां रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
en: Do you along with numbers of heroic monkeys, taking those repressors of foes, the brothers-Rama and Laksmana-when they shall have regained their consciousness, repair to Kiskindha.

sa: कथं च राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिसान्त्वितः। जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं व्यथसे त्वं सदानघ॥
en: But why, O sinless one, albeit comforted by these Rākşasas eager for saying Dasaratha's son, as well as by me, did your persist in your sorrow?

sa: विशालः सुकृतः श्रीमान्सुभूमिः सुसमाहितः॥ अशोभत महान्सेतुः सीमन्त इव सागरे।
en: And spacious, skilfully constructed, graceful, well-paved and nicely finished, the great bridge appeared like the line where the hair has been parted on the Ocean's head.

sa: तस्माद्गच्छ महाबाहो कैलासं धरणीधरम्। निवेशय निवासार्थं त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां सहानुगः॥
en: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, go to the mountain, Kailasa. Do you, along with your retainers, for the purpose of dwelling there, take up your quarters (there).

sa: मारीचकुम्भकर्णाभ्यां वाक्यं मम पितुस्तथा। न कृतं वीर्यमत्तेन तस्येदं फलमीदृशम्॥
en: Maddened with your own prowess you did not hear the word of Mārīca, Kumbhakarņa as well as those of my father-and this is the result thereof.

sa: प्रतिजाने च देवेन्द्र त्वत्समीपे शतक्रतो। भवितास्मि यथास्याहं रक्षसो मृत्युकारणम्॥
en: However I do promise before you, O lord of the celestials, O performer of hundred sacrifices, I shall, soon become the cause of this Räkşasa's death.

sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान्। वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि संगतान् ॥
en: You shall soon observe in a band the heroic monkeys, gifted with the strength of lions and tigers, and having nails and teeth for their weapons.

sa: कोऽसौ पर्वतसंकाशः किरीटी हरिलोचनः। लङ्कायां दृश्यते वीरः सविद्युदिव तोयदः॥
en: Who is that tawny-eyed one, decked with a diadem, and looking like a hill? And in Lankā the hero appear like a of clouds embosoming lightning.

sa: राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः। उक्तवानसि यत्पापं व गतस्तस्य मोक्ष्यसे ॥
en: O you the vilest of the Rākşasas, for using those vicious words towards the spouse of Rāma, of immeasured prowess, repairing whither shall you escape vengeance?

sa: छादयित्वात्मभावं हि चरन्ति शठबुद्धयः। प्रहरन्ति च रन्ध्रेषु सोऽनर्थः सुमहान्भवेत्॥
en: The wicked-minded always move about hiding their real self, and bring about peoples' calamity, taking advantage of their weak points. And great is the disaster thereof.

sa: विस्मयाच्च प्रहर्षाच्च स्नेहाच्च पतिदेवता। उदैक्षत मुखं भर्तुः सौम्यं सौम्यतरानना॥
en: She, having a gentle countenance and always regarding her husband as her god, fixed her looks upon her lord's face out of surprise, joy and love.

sa: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना मारुतेरमितौजसः। इदमेव गमिष्यामि गृहीत्वा शिखरं गिरेः॥
en: Then the thought sprang up in the mind of the Wind-god's offspring of immeasurabie prowess, I shall go, even taking this (entire) summit of the mountain.

sa: ततस्ते विमुखाः सर्वे पतिता धरणीतले। रणात्स्वपुरुषैः शीघ्रं गृहाण्येव प्रवेशिताः॥
en: There upon they were all defeated and fell dead on the ground and all their followers fled away from the field of battle to their homes.

sa: तामसं सुमहाघोरं चकारास्त्रं सुदारुणम्। निर्ददाह कपीन्सवस्तेि प्रपेतुः समन्ततः॥ उत्पपात रजो भूमौ तैर्भग्नैः संप्रधावितैः। नहि तत्सहितुं शेकुर्ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं स्वयम्॥
en: He created a dreadful darkness with the discharge of his sharp weapons and burnt down the monkeys who fled away to different directions. Dust was raised on the ground by those monkeys assailed and flying to various directions. They were unable to withstand the power of the weapon made by Brahmå himself.

sa: स छिनधन्वा रुधिरं वमन्वक्रेण रावणिः। जग्राह कार्मुकश्रेष्ठं दृढज्यं बलवत्तरम्॥
en: Having his bow cut off, Ravana's son, vomiting blood by his mouth, took up a superior bow powerful to a degree and having a stout string.

sa: एवं स तेनाभिहतो विह्वलः शोणितोक्षितः। कृत्तमूल इवाशोको निपपात धनाधिपः॥
en: Thus smitten by him, the lord of wealth, baffled, toppled down to the earth covered with blood like an aśoka whose roots have been hewn away.

sa: पीत्वा घटसहस्रे द्वे गमनायोपचक्रमे। ईषत्समुत्कटो मत्तस्तेजोबलसमन्वितः॥ कुम्भकर्णो बभौ रुष्टः कालान्तकयमोपमः। भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन्रक्षोबलसमन्वितः।। कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् ॥
en: Having drunk two thousand vessels (of wine) he prepared to go. And slightly swollen and flushed, Kumbhakarma, attaining access of strength and fire, waxed wroth and resembled the Doom and Destroyer-Yama himself. And striding to the residence of his brother backed by the Raksasa force, Kumbhakarņa shook the earth with his tread.

sa: नैषा पश्यति राक्षस्यो नेमान् पुष्पफलदुमान्। एकस्थहृदया नूनं राममेवानुपश्यति ॥
en: These Rākşasīs, and these trees enveloped with fruits and flowers-forsooth she dose not behold, but is engaged with all her heart in medidations only touching Rāma.

sa: अयुक्तबुद्धिकृत्येन सर्वभूतविरोधिना। इव प्रयुक्ता रौद्रेण माया मायाविना त्वयि ॥
en: This illusion has been spread around you by that fierce, illusion-creating one, whose mind over runs upon improper acts and who oppose himself to all creatures.

sa: कर्तुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र तेषां त्वमुदकक्रियाम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितः सर्वै रेतदत्र विधीयताम्॥
en: You should, O king of kings, now perform the rites of water to their honour with all your brothers. Let, therefore, the necessary steps be taken.

sa: ब्राह्मणेष्वनृणीभूतः पार्थिवः स्यात् पुरंदर। इतरेषां तु वर्णानां तारयेत् कृशदुर्बलान्॥
en: The king, O Purandara, should free himself from the debt he owes to the Brahmanas and protect the helpless and the weak of the other castes.

sa: यथा सस्यानि रोहन्ति प्रकीर्णानि महीतले। तथा कामाः प्ररोहन्ति भूमिदानसमार्जिताः॥
en: As seeds scattered on the soil grow, and yield a goodly crop, so all one's wishes become successful on account of his making gifts of earth.

sa: ततः पार्थं समासाद्य पाण्डवानां महारथम्। आह्वयामास बीभत्सुं बाल्यान्मोहाच्च संयुगे॥
en: Moved by childishness and folly, he challenged Partha, the powerful car warrior of the Pandavas, famed for dreadful deeds in battle, to an encounter with him.

sa: यौगपद्येन विप्रश्च पुरीद्वारमथाविशत्। ततः स कुणपं दृष्ट्वा सहसा संन्यवर्तत॥
en: And by coincidence, that Brahmana also entered the gate of the city at the same time. Then on seeing the dead body, he suddenly turned away.

sa: सर्वभूतेषु यः सम्यग् ददात्यभयदक्षिणाम्। हिंसादोषविमुक्तात्मा स वै धर्मेण युज्यते॥
en: That man who gives promises of safety to all creatures, freed as his soul becomes from the stain of malice or harmfulness, becomes gifted with virtue.

sa: ततोऽर्चितो ययौ राजस्तदा स तुरगोत्तमः। काशीनगान् कोसलांश्च किरातानथ तेगणान्॥
en: Adored by him, O king, that best of horses then proceeded to the kingdom of the Kashis, the Angas, the Kosalas, the Kiratas, and the Tanganas.

sa: यथा पञ्चसु भूतेषु सम्भूतत्वं नियच्छति। शैत्यात् प्रकुपित: काये तीव्रवायुसमीरितः॥
en: Moved by (another) violent wind, the wind in the body becomes excited through cold, and dissolves away the union of matter into its five primal elements.

sa: आश्लेषायां तु यो रूप्यमृषभं वा प्रयच्छति। स सर्वभयनिर्मुक्तः सम्भवानधितिष्ठति॥
en: He who makes a gift, gift, under under the constellation Ashlesha, of silver or a bull, becomes freed from every fear and acquires riches and prosperity.

sa: तृषितस्तृषिताय त्वं दत्त्वैतद् दर्शनं मम। अजैषीमहतो लोकान् महायज्ञैरिव प्रभो॥
en: Yourself thirsty and hungry, you have by giving me such food, conquered many high regions of happiness, O powerful one, as one does by many sacrifices.

sa: विगाह्य सलिलं त्वाशु बाग्बाणै शविक्षतः। उत्थाय स गदापाणियुद्धाय समुपस्थितः॥
en: Their wordy arrows, penetrating through the waters, pierced Duryodhana. Rising up from the lake, the latter approached the Pandavas, armed with his mace, desirous of battle.

sa: प्राप्स्यसि त्वन्नपानानि यानि वाञ्छसि कानिचित्। मेधाव्यसि कुले जातः श्रुतवाननृशंसवान्॥
en: As regards yourself you will certainly obtain whatever food and drink you may covet, for you are gifted with intelligence, good birth, Vedic learning and mercy.

sa: प्रपात्यमान: श्येनेन कपोतः प्रियदर्शनः। वृषदर्भ महाभागं नरेन्द्रं शरणं गतः॥
en: Once on a time, a beautiful pigeon, pursued by a hawk dropped down from the skies and sought the protection of the highly blessed king Vrishadarbha.

sa: त्रीणि स्रोतांसि यान्यस्मिन्नाप्यायन्ते पुनः पुनः। प्रनाड्यस्तिस्र एवैताः प्रवर्तन्ते गुणात्मिका:॥
en: The three ducts that are in it, support it always. These are ihe three Nadis. They run continually, and have the three qualities for their essence.

sa: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थोऽथ वा पुनः। च इच्छेन्मोक्षमास्थातुमुत्तमा वृत्तिमाश्रयेत्॥
en: A houscholder, or Brahmacharin, or forestrecluse, who would wise to acquire Liberation, should have recourses to that which has been called the best course of conduct.

sa: ततस्तेजःपरीताङ्ग्यः सर्वाः काल उपस्थिते। समं गर्भे सुषुविरे कृत्तिकास्तं नरर्षभ॥
en: Filled with energy as their bodies were, the time at last came for delivery. All of them, it so happened, O prince of men, delivered simultaneously.

sa: एवं सम्पूजितं रक्षो विप्रं तं प्रत्यपूजयत्। सखायमकरोच्चैनं संयोज्याधैर्मुमोच ह॥
en: Thus praised the Rakshasa adored that learned Brahmana in return, and making him his friend and bestowing sufficient riches upon himn in gift, sent him away.

sa: वृत्ते शुद्धे स्थिता नित्यमिन्द्रियैश्चाप्यबाधिताः। उपातिष्ठन्त तं यज्ञं यजन्तस्ते महर्षयः॥
en: They were always observant of a pure conduct and were never obstructed by their senses. Those great, Rishis attended that sacrifice and performed its various rites.

sa: कृताहारं कृताहारा: सर्वे ते विदुरादयः। पाण्डवाश्च कुरुश्रेष्ठमुपातिष्ठन्त तं नृपम्॥
en: After Dhritarashtra had eaten, and Vidura also and others had done the same, the Pandavas, having finished their meals, approached and sat around the old king.

sa: धर्मेणार्थः समाहार्यो धर्मलब्धं त्रिधा धनम्। कर्तव्यं धर्मपरमं मानवेन प्रयत्नतः॥
en: The householder should acquire riches by fair means, The riches thus acquired should be carefully divided into three parts, keeping the requirements of virtue in view.

sa: ते च सर्वे तपस्यन्तः पुरा चेहर्महीमिमाम्। समाधिनोपशिक्षन्तो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्॥
en: Kashyapa and others, formerly, observed the austeresi penances and roved over the world, desirous of acquiring the eternal region of Brahman by the help of Yogameditation.

sa: जालं सुविततं तेषां नवसूत्रकृतं तथा। विस्तारायामसम्पन्नं यत् तत्र सलिलेऽक्षिपन्॥
en: Indeed, they threw upon the water their net which was made of new strings, capable of covering a large space, and having sufficient length and breadth.

sa: गत्वानवाप्य तत् सर्वं नदीवेगसमाप्लुतम्। न पश्यामि तदित्येवं पितरं सोऽब्रवीन्मुनिः॥
en: The son went there, but found all the articles washed away by the current. Returning to his father, he said “I do not see the things."

sa: नित्यं यज्ञोपवीती स्याच्छुक्लवासाः शुचिव्रतः। नियतो यमदानाभ्यां सदा शिष्टैश्च संविशेत्॥
en: One should always bear the sacred thread, wear white (clean) cloths, observe pure vows, and should always mix with good men, making gifts and practising self-control.

sa: लभतां वीरलोकं स ससहायो नराधिपः॥ द्विजाग्र्यैः समनुज्ञातस्त्रिदिवे मोदतां सुखम्।
en: Let that king, with all his associates, obtain the regions reserved for herocs Permitted by foremost of Brahmanas, let him sport blissfully in the celestial region.

sa: वैमनस्यं गतानां च जन्तूनामल्पचेतसाम्। अस्मदर्थे कृते कार्ये दृश्यते प्राणधारणम्॥
en: Of creatures, again, who have lillle intelligence, when their mind becomes distracted and checrless, life is seen to be upheld upon our objects discharging their functions.

sa: अश्रौषं पतितश्चाहं यमस्योच्चैः प्रभाषतः। वासुदेवः समुद्धर्ता भविता ते जनार्दनः॥
en: Though fallen down I still could hear the words that Yama said to me very loudly. Those words were-Janardana the son of Vasudeva, will save you.

sa: यथा चैवापरः पक्षः पूर्वपक्षाद् विशिष्यते। तथा श्राद्धस्य पूर्वाह्वादपराह्वो विशिष्यते॥
en: Then, again, as the dark fortnight is better than the light one, so the afternoon of the day is better than the forenoon for the Shraddha.

sa: यदि वै तादृशा राष्ट्रान् वसेयुस्ते द्विजोत्तमाः। भस्मच्छन्नानिवाग्नीस्तान् बुध्येथास्त्वं प्रयत्नतः॥
en: If such Brahmanas, who must be considered as the foremost of their order, live in your kingdom, you should consider them as fire covered with ashes.

sa: शिलवृत्तिस्तु सिद्धस्य वाक्यैः सम्बोधितस्तदा। गङ्गामुपास्य विधिवत् सिद्धिं प्राप सुदुर्लभाम्॥
en: The poor Brahmana observing the Shila vow, awakened by the words of that ascetic crowned with success, duly sought refuge with Ganga and acquired great success.

sa: पितॄन् देवानृषीन् विप्नानतिथींश्च जनाधिप। यो नरः प्रीणयत्यन्नस्तस्य पुण्यफलं महत्॥
en: The man who pleases with gifts of food the departed manes, the deities, the Rishis, the Brahmanas, and guests arrived at his house, wins great merit.

sa: श्रुतं विचित्रमाख्यानं त्वया पाण्डवनन्दन। सर्पाश्च भस्मसान्नीता गताश्च पदवीं पितुः॥
en: O son of the Pandavas, you have heard a wonderful history. The snakes have been reduced into ashes and have followed the footsteps of your father.

sa: कुटुम्बिने सीदते च ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने। दातव्यं भिक्षवे चान्नमात्मनो भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: Afflicting one's relatives, one, if desirous of his own prosperity, should make gifts of food to a great Brahmana or a person of the mendicant order.

sa: पूर्वमप्येतदेवोक्तं युद्धकाल उपस्थिते। मया तव महाबाहो तस्मादत्र मनः कुरु॥
en: Formerly, when the hour of battle came, this very religion, O you of mighty-arins, was described by me. Do you, therefore, set your mind on it.

sa: स्त्री च भूतेश सततं स्त्रियमेवानुधावति। मया सम्मानिताश्चैव भविष्यन्ति सरिद्वराः॥
en: As for women, O lord of all beings, she follows persons of her sex. By consulting these foremost of Rivers, they will be honoured by me.

sa: मातरः सर्वभूतानां गावः सर्वसुखप्रदाः। वृद्धिमाकाक्षत नित्यं गावः कार्याः प्रदक्षिणाः॥
en: Kine are the mothers of all creatures. They grant every sort of happiness. The person, who seeks his own prosperity, should always make gifts of kine.

sa: उपरोधो भवेदेवमस्माकं तपसः कृते। त्वत्स्नेहपाशबद्धा च हीयेयं तपसः परात्॥
en: By your stay here, our penances will be impeded. Fettered by the ties of my affection for you. I shall fall off from my high penance's.

sa: प्रदानफलवत् तत्र द्रोहस्तत्र तथाफलः। अपचारं गवां तस्माद् वर्जयेत युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: As a gift yields merit, so an act of spoliation brings on to demerit. Hence also, O Yudhishthira one should avoid doing any injury to kine.

sa: तेषां प्रद्रवतां चापि पुनरेवाभिधावताम्॥ निवर्ततां च शब्दोऽभूत् पूर्णस्येव महोदधेः।
en: Many fled, many rushed at Arjuna; many moved not; all of them, however, uttered such a loud noise that it resembled the roar of the Ocean,

sa: इति यास्ताः कथं वीर संरक्ष्याः पुरुषैरिह। स्त्रीणां बुद्ध्यर्थनिष्कर्षादर्थशास्त्राणि शत्रुहन्॥
en: It appears to me that Brihaspati and othur great thinkers, O destroyer of enemies evolved the science of policy from observation of the understanding of women.

sa: देवानामपि देवत्वं युक्तः कारयते वशी। ब्रह्म चाव्ययमाप्नोति हित्वा देहमशाश्वतम्॥
en: The self controlled man, concentrated in Yoga, can create (for himself) the godship of the very gods. Renouncing his transient body he attains to immutable Brahma.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो हविर्दत्तं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति देवताः॥ पितरः सर्वभूतानां नैतेभ्यो विद्यते परम्।
en: The sacrificial offerings given Brahmanas reach the very gods who accept them. Brahmanas are the fathers of all creatures. There is nothing higher than a Brahmana.

sa: अहिंसा परमो धर्मो हिंसा चाधर्मलक्षणा। प्रकाशलक्षणा देवा मनुष्याः कर्मलक्षणाः॥
en: Abstention from injury is the highest duty, Injury is a mark of sin. Splendour is the mark of the deities. Men have acts for their characteristics.

sa: नाहमात्मार्थमिच्छामि रूपं ज्योतिश्च चक्षुषः। तस्मान्मे निर्जितं ज्योतिर्वशे तिष्ठन्ति नित्यदा॥
en: I do not wish for my own self the colour or light which belongs to my eye. Therefore, light subjugated by me, is always under me.

sa: भवांश्चाप्याजवपरः पूर्वं कृत्वा प्रतिश्रयम्। राजवृत्तं न लभते प्रतिज्ञापालने रतः॥
en: You, however, are devoted to sincerity of conduct. Having formerly promised not to take your kingdom, you did not take it, desirous of keeping your promise.

sa: सोऽहं योगबलादेनां रक्षिष्ये पाकशासनात्॥ गात्राणि गात्रैरस्याहं सम्प्रवेक्ष्ये हि रक्षितुम्।
en: I shall, therefore, protect this one from Indra by my Yogapower. For satisfying my object I shall with my body enter the body of this lady.

sa: गर्भस्थस्यास्य बालस्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण निपातनम्। कृत्वा नृशंसं दुर्बुद्धिौणिः किं फलमश्नुते॥
en: Alas, what benefit has been reaped by Drona's son by doing this cruel deed, viz., the destruction of the child in the womb by his Brahma-weapon.

sa: मध्यदेशे महान् ग्रामो ब्राह्मणानां बभूव ह। गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये यामुनस्य गिरेरधः॥
en: In the region lying between the rivers Gangs and Yamuna, at the foot of the hills called Yamuna, there was a large town peopled by Brahmanas.

sa: नारदोऽपि मयि प्राह गुणानेतान् महाद्युते। त्वमप्येतद् विदित्वेह सर्वमाचर पुत्रक॥
en: The celestial Rishi Narada recited to me merits of the several acts mentioned. Informed of those merits, do you, O son, perform the several acts mentioned.

sa: नाहमादातुमिच्छामि ब्रह्मस्वं द्विजसत्तमाः॥ इदं नित्यं मनो विप्रा भ्रातृणां चैव मे सदा। इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंस्तु भ्रातरो द्रौपदी च सा॥ एवमेतदिति प्राहुस्तदभूल्लोमहर्षणम्।
en: You best of twice-born ones, I do not wish to appropriate what now belongs to the Brahmanas. This, you learned Brahmanas, has been the intention of myself and my brothers. When the king said these words, his brothers and Draupadi also said, Yes, it is even so. Grcat was the sensation created by this announcement.

sa: ततः शक्रं समानाय्य देवानाह पितामहः। वरदानान्मम सुरा नहुषो राज्यमाप्तवान्॥
en: The Grandfather having called Indra back, addressed the celestials, saying, You celestials, through the boon I had granted him, Nahusha had obtained the sovereignty of Heaven.

sa: आख्यातव्यश्च भवता यज्ञोऽयं मम सर्वशः। पार्थिवेभ्यो महाबाहो समये गम्यतामिति॥
en: You should also invite them all to this sacrifice of mine. Indeed, O mighty armed one, go forth but try to establish friendly relations with them.

sa: विपुलस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा गुरोश्चिन्तामुपेयिवान्॥ रक्षां च परमां चक्रे देवराजान्महाबलात्।
en: Hearing these words of his preceptor, Vipula began to think, I shall certainly protect this lady in every respect from the powerful king of the celestials.

sa: तामुवाच ततो वह्निर्धार्यतां धार्यतामिति। गर्भो मत्तेजसा युक्तो महागुणफलोदयः ॥
en: To her the god of fire said, Do you carry the seed. Do, indeed, bear the foetus endued with my power. It will produce great results.

sa: इत्युक्ता धर्मराजेन बाष्पव्याकुललोचना। जगामैव तदा कुन्ती गान्धारी परिगृह्य ह॥
en: Though king Yudhishthira said these words to her, with his eyes bathed in tears, Kunti, however, without answering him, continued to go, catching hold of Gandhari.

sa: अपाक्तो यावतः पाङ्क्तान् भुजानानुपश्यति। तावत्फलाद् भ्रंशयति दातारं तस्य बालिशम्॥
en: That Shraddha which is done without sesame seeds, or that which is done by a person in anger, has its Havi robbed by Rakshasas and Pishachas.

sa: कस्येदमिति कस्य स्वमिति बेदवचस्तथा। नाध्यगच्छमहं बुद्ध्या ममेदपिति यद् भवेत्॥
en: (Considering) whose is this, I thought of the Vedic text about anybody's property. I could not therefore, find, through my understanding, what should be (called) mine.

sa: नवनीतपङ्काः क्षीरोदा दधिशैवलसंकुलाः। वहन्ति यत्र वै नद्यस्तत्र यान्ति सहस्रदाः॥
en: Givers of a thousand kine go there where run many rivers, having milk for their water, cheese for their mire, and curds for their floating moss.

sa: एवंशीलसमाचारः स्वर्गे समुपजायते। तत्रासौ भवने दिव्ये मुदा वसति देववत्॥
en: One who is given to such practices and conduct, certainly ascends to Heaven. There he lives like a god in a celestial palace full of comfort.

sa: एष मे सर्वधर्माणां धर्मोऽधिकतमो मतः। यद्भक्त्या पुण्डरीकाक्षं स्तवैरर्चेन्नरः सदा॥
en: This, in my judgment, is the foremost religion of all religions, viz., one should always adore and sing the praises of the lotus-eyed Vasudeva with devotion.

sa: उदात्तकुलजातीय उदात्ताभिजनः सदा। एष धर्मो मया प्रोक्तो विधात्रा स्वयमीरितः॥
en: Even such a person acquires a high birth in this world. This that I have recited to you, was said by the Ordainer (Brahman) himself formerly.

sa: ब्रह्मलोकं महापुण्यं सोमलोकं च शाश्वतम्। गच्छन्ति मुनयः सिद्धाः सत्यधर्मव्यपाश्रयाः॥
en: These Munis, crowned with success and ever given to the Religion of Truth, acquire the highly sacred region of Brahman, or the eternal region of Soma.

sa: इष्ट्वा क्रतुशतेनाथ महता दक्षिणावता। मघवा वाग्विदां श्रेष्ठं पप्रच्छेदं बृहस्पतिम्॥
en: Having worshipped Vishnu in a hundred sacrifices each of which was famous for plentiful gifts, Maghavat put this question to Brihaspati, that foremost of all orators.

sa: ते स्म वीरा दुराधर्षा गाम्भीर्ये सागरोपमाः। शोकोपहतविज्ञाना नष्टसंज्ञा इवाभवन्॥
en: Although those irresistible heroes were grave like the ocean, yet they were now deprived of their knowledge and their very senses by the grief they left.

sa: निदाघकाले वर्षे वा यश्छत्रं सम्प्रयच्छति। नास्य कश्चिन्मनोदाहः कदाचिदपि जायते।
en: That man who makes a gift of an umbrella in the season of summer or rains, has never to suffer from any heartburning on any account.

sa: इत्येतां बुद्धिमास्थाय नहुषः स नरेश्वरः। सुरेन्द्रत्वं महत् प्राप्य कृतवानेतदद्भुतम्॥
en: Filled with such ideas, Nahusha, that great king, when he obtained the sovereignty of the celestials, observed all these rites and duties fraught with great glory.

sa: अमित्रमपि चेद् दीनं शरणैषिणमागतम्। व्यसने योऽनुगृह्णाति स वै पुरुषसत्तमः॥
en: He is, indeed, the foremost of men who shows favour to even an helpless enemy fallen into distress when such enemy comes and prays for help.

sa: वेदविक्रयिणश्चैव वेदानां चैव दूषकाः। वेदानां लेखकाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who sell the Vedas, they who find fault with the Vedas, and they who reduce the Vedas into writing, have all to sink in hell.

sa: अन्तरेण मयाऽऽज्ञप्तश्चिरकारीत्युदारधीः। यद्यद्य चिरकारी स्यात् स मां त्रायेत पातकात्॥
en: Acting carelessly I ordered the great Chirakarin! If on the present occasion he proves true to his name then may he save me from this sin.

sa: सर्वकर्मस्वहिंसा हि धर्मात्मा मनुरब्रवीत्। कामकाराद् विहिंसन्ति बहिर्वेद्यां पशून् नराः॥
en: The pious Manu has spoken highly of harmlessness in all acts. Indeed, men kill animals in sacrifices, actuated only by the desire of fruit. an a

sa: कृष्या ह्यन्नं प्रभवति ततस्त्वमपि जीवसि। पशुभिश्चौषधीभिश्च मा जीवन्ति वाणिज॥
en: From agriculture comes food. That food gives maintenance even to you. With the help of animals, crops and herbs, human beings, O trader, can maintain themselves.

sa: आशायास्तनयोऽधर्मः क्रोधोऽसूयासुतः स्मृतः। लोभः पुत्रो निकृत्यास्तु कृतम्रो नार्हति प्रजाम्॥
en: Expectation has a child named Sin. Anger, again, is considered to be a child of Envy. Cupidity is the child of Deceit. Ingratitude, however, is barnen.

sa: बलिं चैव करिष्यामि पातालतलवासिनम्। दानवं च बलिं श्रेष्ठमवध्यं सर्वदैवतैः॥
en: As regards Vali, that foremost of Danavas, who is to be unslayable by all the gods, I shall cause him to live in the nether regions.

sa: क्षमया क्रोधमुच्छिन्द्यात् कामं संकल्पवर्जनात्। सत्त्वससंसेवनाद् धीरो निद्रां च च्छेत्तुमर्हति॥
en: One should, by practising forgiveness, root out anger and by renouncing all purposes, root out desire. By practising the quality of goodness one should conquer sleep.

sa: यथा धर्मसमाविष्टो धानं गृह्णाति तस्करः। रमते निर्हरन् स्तेनः परवित्तमराजके॥
en: The very thief, stealing others things, spends them in acts of seeming virtue. During anarchy, the thief takes great pleasure in approaching what belongs to others.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि बुद्ध्या संयम्य यत्नतः। सर्वतो निष्पतिष्णूनि पिता बालानिवात्मजान्॥
en: The maddening senses should carefully be governed by the understanding like a father checking his own in experienced children liable to fall into various evil habits.

sa: अकृतेष्वेव कार्येषु मृत्यु सम्प्रकर्षति। युवैव धर्मशीलः स्यादनिमित्तं हि जीवितम्॥
en: Before a person's acts are done, Death drags one away. One should, therefore, begin to practise virtue while he is still young, for life is uncertain.

sa: एवं स्वभावमेवेदमिति विद्वान् न मुह्यति। अशोचन्नप्रहृष्यन् हि नित्यं विगतमत्सरः॥
en: The universe is of the nature. The man of knowledge, therefore, become never stupefied. Such a man never grieves, never rejoices, and is shorn of envy.

sa: यदूर्ध्वं पादतलयोरवाङ्मूर्ध्नश्च पश्यति। यत् तु सम्मोहसंयुक्तमव्यक्तविषयं भवेत्। अप्रतय॑मविज्ञेयं तमस्तदुपधार्यताम्॥
en: All such states of stupefaction whose cause cannot be deterinined (by either reason or inward light), should be known as due to the action of Ignorance.

sa: महाभूतानि पञ्चैव सर्वभूतेषु भूतकृत्। अकरोत् तात वैषम्यं यस्मिन् यदनुपश्यति॥
en: These five elements are in all existent things. The Creator of all things, however, has made an unequal distribution of those elements for serving different ends.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्येण वै लोकान् जयन्ति परमर्षयः। आत्मनश्च ततः श्रेयांस्यन्विच्छन् मनसाऽऽत्मनि॥ वने मूलफलाशी च तप्यन् सुविपुलं तपः। पुण्यायतनचारी च भूतानामविहिंसकः॥ विधूमे सन्नमुसले वानप्रस्थप्रतिश्रये। काले प्राप्ते चरन् भैक्ष्यं कल्पते ब्रह्मभूयसे॥
en: The great Rishis conquer all the worlds by the practice of celebacy. Seeking all things which are good for himself, by fixing the mind the understanding, practising austerities, by living in forest and lying on fruits and roots, by treading on sacred spots, by practising universal benevolence, and by begging alms at the proper time from the huts of herinits when these become smokeless and the sound of the husking rod is hushed a person attains to Brahma.

sa: एतदर्थं महाराज पृष्टः पार्थेन नारदः। ऋषिमध्ये महाभागः शृण्वतोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः॥
en: This very subject was ushered by the highly blessed Partha to Narada in the midst of the Rishis and in the presence of Krishna and Bhishma.

sa: यदा भूयः श्रवणजा सृष्टिरासीन्महात्मनः। ब्रह्मणः पुरुषव्याघ्र तत्र कीर्तयतः शृणु॥
en: In the next birth of the great Brahman when he originated from the ear of Narayana, listen, O king, to what took place in that aeon.

sa: अथ चिन्तयतस्तस्य कर्णाभ्यां पुरुषः स्मृतः। प्रजासर्गकरो ब्रह्मा तमुवाच जगत्पतिः॥
en: While thinking of this, a Being originated from his ears capable to create the universe. The Lord of all called him by the name of Brahman..

sa: अहोरात्रे विभजते सूर्यो मानुषलौकिके। रात्रिः स्वमाय भूतानां चेष्टायै कर्मणामहः॥
en: The sun makes the day and the night for men. The night is for the sleep of all living creatures, and the day is for work.

sa: अत्र वत्स्यामि दुर्धर्षो निःशङ्केनान्तरात्मना॥ सूर्यस्य सदने चाहं निक्षिप्येदं कलेवरम्।
en: There I shall live, invincible by all, and in my inner soul freed from all fear, having renounced this body of mine in the solar region.

sa: नैकेऽश्नन्ति सुसम्पन्नं न गच्छन्ति परस्त्रियम्। सर्वभूतेष्ववर्तन्त यथाऽऽत्मनि दयां प्रति॥
en: None amongst them ate singly any food that was good, and none had known other people's wives. They treated all creatures as to their own selves.

sa: अशक्तः पूर्वमासीस्त्वं कथञ्चिच्छक्ततां गतः। कस्त्वदन्य इमां वाचं सुत्रां वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: Formerly, however, you could not behave so. Now you have somehow gained that power. Indeed, who else save you could give vent to such cruel words?

sa: इति संचोदितस्तेन धीरो निश्चितनिश्चयः। उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा स्वां प्रज्ञामनुवर्णयन्॥
en: Thus urged by Indra, the king of the Daityas, endued with firinness and with fixed conclusions about truth, replied in these sweet words showing great wisdom.

sa: केन मृत्युर्गृहस्थेन धर्ममाश्रित्य निजितः। इत्येतत् सर्वमाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेनापि च पार्थिव॥
en: O king, tell me if any householder has ever succeeded in conquering Death by the practice of virtue! Do you recite this to me in full.

sa: एवं पञ्चत्रिका ह्येते गुणास्तदुपलब्धये। येनायं त्रिविधो भावः पर्यायात् समुपस्थितः॥
en: These fifteen attributes are necessary for the several kinds of perception. In consequence of them, every man becomes conscious of three separate things regarding those perceptions.

sa: विश्वामित्रस्य विपुला नदी देवर्षिसेविता। कौशिकी च शिवा पुण्या ब्रह्मर्षिसुरसेविता॥
en: Vishvamitra had a large river, named Kaushiki, that was frequented by celestial Rishis. This sacred and suspicious river was frequented by the celestials and twiceborn Rishis.

sa: देवर्षि तु शुको दृष्ट्वा नारदं समुपस्थितम्। अर्थ्यपूर्वेण विधिना वेदोक्तेनाभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Seeing the celestial Rishi Narada arrived at his asylum, Shuka adored him by offering him the Arghya according to the rites laid down in the Vedas.

sa: एते प्रजानां पतयः समुद्दिष्टा यशस्विनः। अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान्॥
en: These that I have named are noted as the illustrious Patriarchs. After this, I shall name the celestials who are the lords of the three worlds.

sa: केशवो भरतश्रेष्ठ भगवानीश्वरः प्रभुः। पुरुषः सर्वमित्येव श्रूयते बहुधा विभुः॥
en: Keshava, O chief of Bharata's race, is the divine and powerful Lord of all. He is called Purusha, and is present in everything, having multiplied himself.

sa: चत्वारो लोकपालाश्च देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा॥ तत्र नित्यं समायान्ति लोकस्य हितकाम्यया।
en: The four Regents of the world, the gods, and various classes of Rishis, used always to come there from desire of doing good to the world.

sa: तस्यापरोक्षं विज्ञानं षडङ्गेषु बभूव ह। वेदेषु चैव निष्णातो हिमवत्पादसंश्रयः॥
en: He acquired (by his austerities) spiritual insight into the various branches of the Vedas. Residing at the foot of Himavat, he was devoted to the Vedas,

sa: एवमुक्ता तदा कृष्ण माता मे सुतवत्सला। मूर्धन्याघ्राय गोविन्द सबाष्पाकुललोचना॥
en: After I had said these words, O Krishna, to my mother, she, filled with parental affection, smelt my head, O Govinda, her eyes bathed in tears.

sa: भृगुरुवाच ब्रह्मकल्पे पुरा ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मर्षीणां समागमे। लोकसम्भवसंदेहः समुत्पन्नो महात्मनाम्॥
en: O twice-born one, in very ancient times called the Brahma-Kalpa, great Rishis, when they assembled together, felt this very doubt about the creation of the universe.

sa: वर्षाहिमातपानां च परित्राणानि कुर्वते। चैलमन्नं सुखं शय्यां निवातं चोपभुञ्जते॥
en: They can make shelters for themselves against rain, cold and heat. They can also enjoy excellent clothes for themselves, good food, comfortable beds, and excellent houses.

sa: तं पुत्रपशुसम्पन्नं व्यासक्तमनसं नरम्। सुप्तं व्याघ्रो मृगमिव मृत्युरादाय गच्छति॥
en: Like a tiger carrying away a sleeping deer, Death takes away the man addicted to the gratification of desire and the enjoyment of sons and animals.

sa: मोहेन हि समाविष्टः पुत्रदारार्थमुद्यतः। कृत्वा कार्यमकार्यं वा पुष्टिमेषां प्रयच्छति॥
en: Possessed by ignorance, one is ready to work hard for sons and wives. Doing good or evil deeds, one brings them up and advances their interest.

sa: भुक्तवन्तं च तं विप्रं प्रीतात्मानं महातपाः। क्लमापनयनार्थं स पक्षाभ्यामभ्यवीजयत्॥
en: After the Brahmana had eaten and became satisfied, the bird having asceticism for his wealth began to fan him with his wings for removing his fatigue.

sa: तदा विशुद्धो भवति प्रकृतेः परिवर्जनात्। अन्योऽहमन्येयमिति यदा बुध्यति बुद्धिमान्॥
en: By shaking off Nature and beginning to realise that he is different from her, the intelligent Soul then comes to be regarded as pure and stainless.

sa: उपमन्युरुवाच एतान् दत्त्वा वरान् देवो वन्द्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः। स्तूयमानश्च विबुधैस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Upamanyu said Having given to Tandin these boons and received the adorations of both the gods and the Rishis, the great Deity disappeared there and then.

sa: क्रमशः संचितशिखो धर्मबुद्धिमयो महान्। अन्धकारे प्रवेष्टव्यं दीपो यत्नेन धार्यताम्॥
en: When you are destined to enter into the dark, do you hold up the blazing lamp or righteous understanding and whose flame has been sufficiently kept.

sa: भक्ष्यं पेयमथालेह्यं यच्चान्यत् साधु भोजनम्। प्रेक्षमाणेषु योऽश्नीयान्नृशंसमिति तं वदेत्॥
en: Know him for a malevolent and a wicked person who quietly and alone takes choice foods and drinks even when persons stand by with eager eyes.

sa: अनिन्दितो ह्यकामात्मा नाल्पेष्वर्थ्यनसूयकः। समुद्रकल्पः स नरो न कथंचन पूर्यते॥
en: He never incurs obloquy. He is free from envy. He is never satisfied with trivial acquisitions. He is like the ocean which can never be filled.

sa: तस्य विश्रमणादेष प्रसादो मत्कृतस्तव। रक्ष्यसे तेन दुर्बुद्धे नात्मवीर्याद् दुमाधम॥ यन्मां त्वमवजानीषे यथान्यं प्राकृतं तथा। दर्शयाम्येष चात्मानं यथा मां नावमन्यसे॥
en: For this incident I have hitherto shown you favour. O worst of trees, it is for this that you stand uninjured and not for your own power. You consider me lightly as if I were a vulgar thing. I shall, however, appear to you in such a way that you may not disrespect me again.

sa: सार्थिका वणिजश्चापि तापसाश्च वनौकसः। वसन्ति तत्र मार्गस्थाः सुरम्ये नगसत्तमे॥
en: While travelling, caravans of merchants and traders, and ascetics living in the forest, used to rest under the shade of that charming king of the forest.

sa: इत्युक्तास्ते सुतं त्यक्त्वा भूमौ शोकपरिप्लुताः। दह्यमानाः सुतस्नेहात् प्रययुर्बान्धवा गृहम्॥
en: Thus addressed, the men, laden with sorrow and burning with grief on account of their love for the child, departed for their homes, leaving the body.

sa: एषोऽप्ययस्ते राजेन्द्र यथावत् समुदाहृतः। अध्यात्ममधिभूतं च अधिदैवं च श्रूयताम्॥
en: I have thus, O king, duly told you of Destruction. I shall now describe to you the subject of Adhyatma (Spiritual), Adhibhuta (Eternal) and Adhidaivata (Accidental).

sa: सत्त्वमानन्द उद्रेकः प्रीतिः प्राकाश्यमेव च। सुखं शुद्धित्वमारोग्यं संतोषः श्रद्दधानता॥ अकार्पण्यमसंरम्भः क्षमा धृतिरहिंसता। समता सत्यमानृण्यं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्॥ शौचमार्जवमाचारमलौल्यं हृद्यसम्भ्रमः। इष्टानिष्टवियोगानां कृतानामविकत्थना॥ दानेन चात्मग्रहणमस्पृहत्वं परार्थता। सर्वभूतदया चैव सत्त्वस्यैते गुणाः स्मृताः॥
en: Patience, joy, prosperity, satisfaction, brightness of all faculties, happiness, purity, health, contentment, faith, liberality, mercy, forgiveness, firinness, benevolence, equanimity, truth, satisfaction of obligations, mildness, modesty, calmness, external purity, simplicity, observance of obligatory rites, dispassionateness, fearlessness of heart, disregard for good and evil as also for pristine deeds,-appropriation of objects only when acquired by gift, the absence of cupidity, regard for the interests of others, mercy for all crcatures, these have been said to be the characteristics of the quality of Goodness.

sa: विदितो भगवानस्य कार्यमागमनस्य यत्। पश्यैनं त्वं महाभागं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा॥
en: The illustrious Lord of Riches is well acquainted with the object of this hour journey See him that blessed Master, who blazes with his own energy

sa: स्वयुक्तः पश्यते ब्रह्म यत् तत्परममव्ययम्। महतस्तमसो मध्ये स्थितं ज्वलनसंनिभम्॥
en: While in contemplation, the Yogin sees Brahma which is Supreme and Immutable, and which is situated like a burning Effulgence in the midst of thick Darkness.

sa: काम्यया पृष्टवांस्त्वं मां ततो व्याहृतमुत्तमम्। अनतिक्रमणीया सा कृत्स्नैर्लोकैस्त्रिभिः सदा॥
en: Through desire I had solicited you. You gave me the very best answer. People of the three worlds cannot get over the desire for sexual union.

sa: तया चाहमनुज्ञातो भवांश्चापि प्रकीर्तितः। श्रावितश्चापि तद्वाक्यं गृहं चाभ्यागतः प्रभो॥
en: I was received by her with courtesy. She named you before me, and also instructed me in various matters. Having listened to her I have returned,Olord.

sa: जरामृत्युमहाग्राहे न कश्चिदभिपद्यते। नैवास्य कश्चिद् भवति नासौ भवति कस्यचित्॥
en: As one is swept along that current, one does not find any friend for help and one does not feel any interest for any one else.

sa: तथा रोगाभिभूतस्य नित्यं कृच्छ्रगतस्य च। नास्ति भार्यासमं किंचिन्नरस्यार्तस्य भेषजम्॥
en: One, who is suffered from disease and surrounded with many troubles, his wife is the best of panaceas and good medicine in sickness of that person.

sa: उक्तवाक्ये तु नृपतौ सुलभा चारुदर्शना। ततश्चारुतरं वाक्यं प्रचक्रामाथ भाषितुम्॥
en: After the king had said these words, the beautiful Sulabha then gave vent to the following words in reply which were more handsome than her person.

sa: एवं विदित्वा सर्वार्थानारभेतेति वैदिकम्। नारभेतेति चान्यत्र नैष्ठिकी श्रूयते श्रुतिः॥
en: Knowing these, perform acts which lead to heaven and other blessings,—this is a Vedic declaration.-Do not perform acts,—this also is another obligatory declaration of the Vedas.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच स्थायतामिति तच्छुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य पयस्विनी। अाञ्चितशिरोग्रीवा प्रबभौ रौद्रदर्शना॥
en: The Gandharva said : Having heard the word 'Stay,' that cow of Vasishtha (Nandini) raised up her head and neck and became fearful to look at.

sa: दृष्ट्वा ते तत्र पश्यन्तीं सर्वे कृष्णां यशस्विनीम्। सप्रेक्ष्यान्योन्यमासीना हृदयैस्तामधारयन्॥
en: She too looked at them all. Glancing at the illustrious Krishna (Draupadi), they looked at one another and taking their seats, they thought of her alone.

sa: भ्रामयित्वा शतगुणमेकोनं येन भारत। गदा क्षिप्ता बलवता मागधेन गिरिव्रजात्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the greatly powerful king of Magadha whirled a club ninety nine times and he hurled it towards Mathura from Girivraja (his capital).

sa: जिगीषया ततो देवा वव्रिरेऽऽङ्गिरसं मुनिम्। पौरोहित्येन याज्यार्थे काव्यं तूशनसं परे॥ ब्राह्मणौ तावुभौ नित्यममन्योन्यस्पर्धिनौ भृशम्। तत्र देवा निजघ्नुर्यान् दानवान् युधि संगतान्॥ तान् पुनर्जीवयामास काव्यो विद्याबलाश्रयात्। ततस्ते पुनरुत्थाय योधयांचक्रिरे सुरान्॥
en: From the desire of securing victory, the celestials appointed the Rishi who was the son of Angirasa (Brihaspati) as their priest to conduct their sacrifices; and their opponents appointed Ushanas (Shukra) as their priest for the same purpose. There was much boastful rivalry between these two Brahmanas. All those Danavas that were killed in battle by the Devas were revived by that sage (Shukra) with the power of his knowledge; and they, thus being made alive, fought again with the celestial.

sa: स कदाचिदथो राजा श्रीमानमितविक्रमः। चचार मृगयां पार्थ पर्वतोपवने किल॥
en: O Partha, once a time that king, blessed with good fortune and endued with great prowess, went out to hunt in the woods on the mountains.

sa: ब्रह्मदण्डं महाघोरं कालाग्निसमतेजसम्। नाशयिष्यामि मात्र त्वं भयं कार्षीः कथंचन॥
en: I shall extinguish this (fire), this terrible punishment, blazing as the fire of the end of the Yuga. You should not entertain any fear any longer.

sa: तरुणी दर्शनीयासि समर्था भतुरेषणे। अनुगच्छ पतिं मातः पुत्रानाप्स्यसि शोभनान्॥
en: You are young and handsome you are able to search for your husband. O mother, go to your husband and you will obtain excellent sons again.

sa: अन्वीयमानः शुशुभे शिष्यैरिव गुरुः प्रियैः। पार्थमामन्त्र्य गोविन्दः परिष्वज्य सुपीडितम्॥
en: Shone like a preceptor followed by his beloved pupils. After bidding farewell to Partha (Arjuna) Govinda (Krishna) cmbraced him firmly (with all the ardour of love).

sa: स त्वं सम्राड्गुणैर्युक्तः सदा भरतसत्तम। क्षत्रे सम्राजमात्मानं कर्तुमर्हसि भारत॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O descendant of Bharata, you alone are worthy of becoming an emperor. You should establish your empire over all Kshatriyas.

sa: तं विजित्य महाबाहुः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। प्रययावुत्तरां तस्माद् दिशं धनदपालिताम्॥
en: Having thus conquered him, the mighty armed son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, then went towards the north, the direction presided over by the lord of wealth (Kubera).

sa: तं चापि पुरुषव्याघ्रो बाहुवीर्येण पाण्डवः। निहत्य तरसा वीरो नागरान्पर्यसान्त्वयत्॥
en: The best of men, the son of Pandu, Bhima, soon killed him with the strength of his arms and thus made the citizens safe and fearless.

sa: य इदं श्रावयेद्विद्वान्ये चेदं शृणुयुर्नराः। ते ब्रह्मणः स्थानमेत्य प्राप्नुयुर्देवतुल्यताम्॥
en: The learned man who reads it to others and those that hear it read, go to the world of Brahma and become equal to the celestials.

sa: पितामह उवाच एष लोकविनाशाय रविरुद्यन्तुमुद्यतः। दृश्यन्नेव हि लोकान्स भस्मराशीकरिष्यति॥
en: Brahma said: The sun is ready to rise in order to destroy the worlds. As soon as he will rise he will burn everything into ashes.

sa: षडङ्गश्चाखिलो वेद इमं गर्भस्थमेव ह। विवेश भृगुवंशस्य भूयः प्रियचिकीर्षया॥
en: So that he may do good to the Bhrigu race, the entire Vedas with their six Angas came to him when he was in the womb.

sa: आत्मनः प्रतिरूपोऽसौ लब्धः पतिरिति स्थिते। विचित्रवीर्यं कल्याण्यौ पूजयामासतुः शुभे॥
en: The beautiful and amiable damsels, endued with every auspicious mark, considered their husband Vichitravirya in every war worthy of them; and they loved and respected him.

sa: ऊर्ध्वसस्याभवद् भूमिः सस्यानि रसवन्ति च। यथर्तुवर्षी पर्जन्यो बहुपुष्पफला दुमाः॥
en: The land gave abundant harvests and the crops were juicy. The clouds showered rains at proper time and the trees became full of fruits and flowers.

sa: तैरेव सहितः सर्वैरनुरज्य च तान् नृपान्। उलक्वासिनं राजन् बृहृतमुपजग्मिवान्॥
en: O king, having won the affection of those kings, and having united himself with them, he next marched against Brihanta (who was) the king of Uluka.

sa: एवं लालप्यतस्तस्य भार्यार्थे दुःखितस्य च। देवदूतस्तदाऽभ्येत्य वाक्यमाह रुरुं वने।॥
en: While he was thus lamenting in sorrow for the loss of his bride a heaven's messenger came to him in the forest and addressed hiin thus:

sa: प्राज्ञः प्राज्ञप्रलापज्ञः प्रलापज्ञमिदं वचः। प्राज्ञं प्राज्ञः प्रलापज्ञः प्रलापज्ञं वचोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: The learned man (Vidura) conversant with the (Mlecha) Jargon, spoke thus to the learned man (Yudhisthira), also conversant with the (Mlecha) jargon (in that Mlecha jargon)."

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ततस्ते भरतश्रेष्ठ काशिराजसुते शुभे। तं बालमभिपद्याशु प्रस्रवैरभ्यषिञ्चताम्॥
en: Krishna said O best of the Bharata race, having obtained the child, the handsome daughters of the king of Kashi drenched it with their lacteal streams.

sa: प्रसुप्तं निशि विश्वस्तं जघ्नुौधिष्ठिरं बलम्। यत्तु शौनकसत्रे ते भारताख्यानमुत्तमम्॥
en: Destroyed the army of Yudhishthira when his soldiers were unsuspectingly sleeping. O Shaunaka, the best of narrations, the Bharata, which is narrated here at your sacrifice,

sa: शकुनि म यस्त्वासीद्राजा लोके महारथः। द्वापरं विद्धि तं राजन्संभूतमरिमर्दनम्॥
en: O king, that king and great car-warrior, that chastiser of foes, who was known as Shakuni in the world, know him to be the Dvapara himself.

sa: अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाः पितामहमुवाच ह। एषां लोकं जनौघानां दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत॥
en: There upon the highly effulgent Vişņu said to the Patriarch Brahmă:-It behove you, O you of good vows, to allot to those people their proper regions.

sa: ततः पाण्डुर्महाराजो मन्त्रयित्वा महर्षिभिः। दिदेश कुन्त्याः कौरव्यो व्रतंसांवत्सरं शुभम्॥
en: Thereupon the descendant of Kuru, the great king Pandu, after consulting with the great Rishis, commanded Kunti to observe an auspicious vow for one full year.

sa: आख्यातं यत्र पौराणं त्रिपुरस्य निपातनम्। प्रयाणे परुषश्चात्र संवादः कर्णशल्ययोः॥
en: Then is told the old story of the death of Tripura; the interchange of strong words between Karna and Shalya on their setting out to battle.

sa: अस्मिंस्त्वर्थान्तरे युक्तमनर्थः प्रतिपद्यते। तस्मान्न प्रतपत्तिस्तु कार्या युक्ता मता मम॥
en: This affair that promises to terminate Otherwise may lead to a great mischief. It is my opinion, therefore, that the proposed task should not be undertaken.

sa: तस्याऽष्टौ वसवः पुत्रास्तेषां वक्ष्यामि विस्तरम्। धरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च अहश्चैवानिलोऽनलः॥
en: The sons of Prajapati were eight and they were called the Vasus. I shall name them in detail. (They were) Dhara, Dhruva, Soma, Aha, Anila, Anala,

sa: साक्षाद् बृहस्पतेः शिष्यो महाबुद्धिर्महामनाः॥ सत्यकः सात्यकिश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः।
en: Who was a man of great soul and great intelligence, like a disciple of Brihaspati himself. (There also came) Satyaka and Satyaki and Kritavarmana and Satvata,

sa: दाशानां भुजवेगेन नद्याः स्रोतोजवेन च। वायुना चानुकूलेन तूर्णं पारमवाप्नुवन्॥
en: Aided by the strength of arms of the boatmen and by the rapidity of the current and favourable wind, they then speedily reached the opposite bank.

sa: यशसोऽर्थाय चैव त्वं कुरु कर्म सुदुष्करम्। प्राप्याधिपत्यमिन्द्रेण यज्ञैरिष्टं यशोऽर्थिना॥
en: In order to gain fame, do this difficult work for me. Indra, through he has obtained the sovereignty of the celestials, performs sacrifices for fame alone.

sa: आज्ञापितं मामशने रुदन्तं सह बन्धुभिः। ददर्श ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन्मन्त्रसिद्धो महामनाः॥
en: Seeing me weeping with my friends when I was ordered to supply the food (for the Rakshasas ), a high-minded Brahmana, learned in Mantras, saw me.

sa: वृत्तेनाराध्य तान् सर्वान् गुरून् पतिपरायणा। वाचापि पुरुषानन्यान् सुव्रता नान्वकीर्तयत्॥
en: She, ever-devoted to her husband, pleased her superiors by her good conduct and vowobserving as she was, she never referred to other men even in words.

sa: रुदन्तस्तेऽथ शर्मिष्ठामभ्ययुर्बालकास्ततः। श्रुत्वा तु तेषां बालानां सव्रीड इव पार्थिवः॥
en: The boys wept in grief and they left the place, going towards their mother. The king became very much abashed of this conduct of the boys.

sa: स्वभावादगमच्छब्दो महीं सागरमेखलाम्। अर्जुनस्य समो लांके नास्ति कश्चिद् धनुर्धरः॥
en: There arose a great shout covering the whole earth, bounded by the belt of sea. “There was no bowman in the whole world equal to Arjuna.”

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच द्रुपदेनैवमुक्तस्तु भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्। मुहूर्तं चिन्तयित्वा तु मन्युनाभिपरिप्लुतः॥ स विनिश्चित्य मनसा पाञ्चालं प्रति बुद्धिमान्। जगाम कुरुमुख्यानां नगरं नागसाह्वयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus addressed by Drupada, the powerful son of Bharadvaja, was filled with anger and reflecting for a moment. That wise man made up his mind as to his course of action with regard to the king of Panchala, He then went to the city of the foremost of the Kurus, named Hastinapur.

sa: यदा न प्रतिषेद्धारस्तयोः सन्तीह केचन। निरुद्योगौ तदा भूत्वा विजह्रातेऽमराविव॥
en: When they saw they had no rival, like the immortals they gave up all labour and exertion and they passed their time in pleasures and merriments.

sa: अनाधृष्टिरभूत् तेषां विद्वान् भुवि तथैकराट्। ऋचेयुरथ विक्रान्तो देवानामिव वासवः॥
en: Amongst them all, Richeyu became the sole lord of the whole earth and was known by the name of Anadhrishti. He was in prowess like Indra.

sa: पौलोमे भृगुवंशस्य विस्तारः परिकीर्तितः। आस्तीके सर्वनागानां गरुडस्य च संभवः॥
en: In Pauloma Parva the account of the Bhrigu and his descendants has been narrated. Astika contains the account of the birth of Garuda all the Nagas,

sa: शरणं च प्रपन्नास्मि त्वामद्य पुरुषोत्तम। दीनाननाथान् कौन्तेय परिरक्षसि नित्यशः॥
en: O best of men I solicit protection. O son of Kunti, you always protect the distressed and the helpless. Weeping in sorry I solicit your protection.

sa: या पुरोक्ता भगवता तिर्यग्योनिगता शुभा। मानुषौ जनयित्वा त्वं शापमोक्षमवाप्स्यति॥
en: Because she had been told before by the illustrious one that she would be released from her piscatorial form after giving birth to two human children.

sa: व्रीडमाना स्रजं कुन्ती राज्ञः स्कन्धे समासृजत्। तं निशम्य वृतं पाण्डु कुन्त्या सर्वे नराधिपाः॥ यथागतं समाजग्मुर्गजैरश्वैः रथैस्तथा। ततस्तस्याः पिता राजन्विवाहमकरोत्प्रभुः॥
en: Kunti advanced in modesty, quivering with emotion and placed the nuptial garland round the neck of the king (Pandu). Finding that Kunti had chosen Pandu, the other kings returned to their kingdoms on elephants, on horses and cars on which they had come. O king, her father then performed the nuptial rites in due form.

sa: अस्यैतन्मानसं शल्यं समुद्धर्तुं त्वमर्हसि। जनन्याः शाप देव ज्ञातीनां हितमिच्छतः॥
en: You should draw out the dart, begotten by his mother's curse, which pierces the heart of Vasuki who is desirous of the weal of his race.

sa: तपसाऽऽराध्य वरदं देवं गोपतिमीश्वरम्। लेभे संवरणो भार्यां वसिष्ठस्यैव तेजसा॥
en: Thus Samvarana obtained (Tapati) as his wife by worshipping the propitious lord (Surya) by ascetic penances and by the help of the great effulgence of Vasishtha.

sa: ततः स मृगयामास वने तस्मिंस्तयोधनः। नाध्यगच्छच मृगयंस्तां गां मुनिरुदारधीः॥
en: The noble-minded and greatly intelligent ascetic searched for the cow everywhere in the woods; but though he searched long, yet he could he not find her.

sa: चन्द्रादित्यौ ग्रहास्तारा नक्षत्राणि दिवौकसः। जग्मुर्विषादं तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वा सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः॥
en: The moon, the sun, the planets, the stars, the constellations and the dwellers of heaven, became exceedingly sorry on seeing these works of Sunda and Upasunda.

sa: ततः स पितुराय तामुवाच यशस्विनीम्। अधिरोह रथं मातर्गच्छावः स्वगृहानिति॥
en: He (Bhishma) them for the sake of his father, addressed the illustrious (lady) thus, “O mother, ascend this chariot and let us go to our home."

sa: अवलोकेषु नारीणां सहस्राणि शतानि च। भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकानां च समवायो महानभूत्॥
en: In order to see him hundreds and thousands of women and men of the Vrishni, the Andhaka and the Bhoja races formed into a great crowd.

sa: यदाश्रौषं चास्मदीयान्महारथान् व्यवस्थितानर्जुनस्यान्तकाय। संशप्तकान् निहतानर्जुनेन तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the mighty car-warriors Sansaptakas, appointed to defeat Arjuna, had been all killed by him.

sa: ब्रह्म पर्यचरत् क्षत्रं विशः क्षत्रमनुव्रताः। ब्रह्मक्षत्रानुरक्ताश्च शूद्राः पर्यचरन् विशः॥
en: The Brahmanas were served by the Kshatriyas; the Kshatriyas were served by the Vaishyas; the Shudras, adoring both the Brahmanas and the Kshatriyas, served the Vaishyas.

sa: सा प्रसादयती देवमिदं भूयोऽभ्यभाषत। एकं पतिं गुणोपेतं त्वत्तोऽर्हामीति शंकर॥
en: She who had been able to please the deity said again, “O Shankara, I desire to have from you only one husband endued with all accomplishments."

sa: जनयामास यं काली शक्तेः पुत्रात्पराशरात्। कन्यैव यमुनाद्वीपे पाण्डवानां पितामहम्॥
en: The grandfather of the Pandavas, (Krishna Dvaipayana) was born in an island of the Yamuna, in the womb of the maiden Kali by Shakti's son Parashara.

sa: स तस्य मनुजेन्द्रस्य पश्यतो भगवानृषिः। अर्ध्वमाचक्रमे द्रष्टुं भास्करं भास्करद्युतिः॥
en: In the very sight of the king, the illustrious Rishi ascended the sky in order to see Surya, he himself being as effulgent as that luminary.

sa: तं निवारयितुं शक्तो नान्योऽस्ति भुवि कश्चन। त्वदृतेऽद्य महाभाग सर्ववेदविदांवर॥
en: O illustrious Sir, O best of all learned men in the Vedas, there is none else except you in the world who can restrain him today.

sa: आस्तीकं प्रेषयामास गृहानेव सुसंस्कृतम्। राजा प्रीतमनाः प्रीतं कृतकृत्यं मनीषिणम्॥
en: He sent back home in much joy the wise Astika, whom he treated with every respect. He too was exceedingly pleased, because his object was attained.

sa: द्विवर्षसम्भृता कुक्षौ तामुत्स्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे। अथ द्वैपायनो ज्ञात्वा त्वरितः समुपागमत्॥
en: She bone in her womb for two years. To seeing hard mass of flesh, she decided to throw it. Dvaipayana, knowing it, soon came to her.

sa: कुमाराश्च कुमारीश्च पुनः क्षत्राभिवृद्धये। एवं तद्ब्राह्मणै क्षत्रं क्षत्रियासु तपस्विभिः॥
en: And many boys and girls, in order to thrive the Kshatriya race. Thus sprang the Kshatriya race from Kshatriya women from their connections with ascetic Brahmanas.

sa: निधिप्रवरमुख्यौ च शङ्खपद्मौ धनेश्वरौ। सर्वान् निधीन् प्रगृह्याथ उपासाते धनेश्वरम्॥
en: Those best of Jewels, those princes of all wealth, Shankha and Padma (in their personified forms) accompanied by all gems, wait upon the lord of wealth.

sa: तथापि परिभूयैनं प्रेक्षमाणो वृकोदरः। राक्षसं भुक्त एवान्नं पाण्डवः परवीरहा॥ अमर्षेण तु सम्पूर्णः कुन्तीपुत्रं वृकोदरम्। जघान पृष्ठे पाणिभ्यामुभाभ्यां पृष्ठतः स्थितः॥
en: That slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Pandu (Bhima), even then disregarding him and casting on him only a single glance, continued to eat the food of the Rakshasas. Being filled with great displeasure, he (the Rakshasas) struck a heavy blow with both his hands on the back of the son of Kunti, Vrikodara.

sa: पितॄणां च गणान् विद्धि सप्तैव पुरुषर्षभ। मूर्तिमन्तो हि चत्वारस्त्रयश्चाप्यशरीरिणः॥
en: O best of men, know that there are seven classes of Pitris, of which four classes have embodied forms, the three remaining classes have no forms.

sa: भवनं श्रेष्ठमासाद्य वीरपत्नी वराङ्गना।॥ ववन्दे पृथुताम्राक्षी पृथां भद्रा यशस्विनी।
en: Arriving at that best of houses, that wife of a hero, the best of women, the illustrious Bhadra (Subhadra) of large and radish eyes worshipped Pritha.

sa: ततो वासगृहं रम्यं पन्नगेन्द्रस्य संमतम्। जगाम भार्यामादाय स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः॥
en: He then being much adored by the Rishis lived with his wife in the beautiful house set apart for him by the king of the snakes.

sa: ततोऽभिवाद्य गोविन्दः पादौ जग्राह धर्मवित्। उत्थाप्य धर्मराजस्तु मूर्युपाघ्राय केशवम्॥
en: Govinda (Krishna) learned in all the precepts of virtue, then worshipped Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) and touched his feet. He (Yudhishthira) raised Keshava up and smelt his head.

sa: वर्तमानः सतां वृत्ते पुत्रलाभमवाप्य च। पितृलोकं गतः पाण्डुरितः सप्तदशेऽहनि॥
en: Steadily adhering to the path of the virtuous and the wise and leaving behind him these children, Pandu has gone to the land of the Pitris.

sa: अन्तःपुरं ततस्तस्य ब्राह्मणस्य महात्मनः। विवेश त्वरिता कुन्ती बद्धवत्सेव सौरभी॥
en: As the Kamadhenu (the all-boon giving cow) runs at her tethered calf, so Kunti ran in all hurry to the inner apartment of the highsouled Brahmana.

sa: सम्प्रयुक्तस्तु कुन्त्या च माद्र्या च भरतर्षभ। जिततन्द्रीस्तदा पाण्डुर्बभूव वनगोचरः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, some time after, Pandu, who had mastered over his senses, retired into a forest with (his wives) Kunti and Madri.

sa: रक्षसा तं गृहीतं तु विदित्वा मुनिसत्तमः। विश्वामित्रोऽप्यपाक्रामत् तस्माद् देशादरिंदम॥
en: O chastiser of foes, knowing that the Rakshasas had entered the body of the king, that best of Rishis, Vishvamitra, left the place and went away.

sa: तक्षक उवाच यावद्धनं प्रार्थयसे तस्माद्राज्ञस्ततोऽधिकम्। अहमेव प्रदास्यामि निवर्तस्व द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Takshaka said : O best of Brahmanas, I shall give you wealth more than you hope to get from the king. Therefore do not go. w

sa: शूद्रायां गौतमो यत्र महात्मा संशितव्रतः। औशीनर्यामजनयत् काक्षीवाद्यान् सुतान् मुनिः॥
en: This was the place where the illustrious Gotama of the rigid vows begot on the daughter of Ushinara, s Shudra woman Kakshivana and other famous sons.

sa: न तु शक्यं जरासंधे जीवमाने महाबले। राजसूयस्त्वयावाप्तुमेषा राजन् मतिर्मम॥
en: O king, but it is my opinion that you will not be able to perform the Rajasuya (Sacrifice), so long the greatly powerful Jarasandha remains alive.

sa: तेन गन्धवतीत्येवं नामास्याः प्रथितं भुवि। तस्यास्तु योजनाद्गन्धमाजिघ्रन्त नरा भुवि॥
en: Thenceforth she become known among men by the name of Gandhavati (sweetscented.) Men could smell sweet scent of her body from a distance of a Yojana.

sa: स युद्धकुशलः पार्थो बाहुवीर्येण चातुलः। अहनत् कुञ्जरानीकं गदया कालरूपधृत्॥
en: Those huge animals like mountains, struck with Bhima's club, had their heads broken into pieces and they fill covered with blood, like cliffs loosened by thunder.

sa: कृताञ्जलयः सर्वे प्रणता वसुधाधिपाः। उपाजग्मुर्धनं गृह्य रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: All the kings of the world bowed to him with joined hands and they waited upon him with presents of various kinds of gems and wealth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कतिपयाहस्य तस्मिन् रैरतके गिरौ। वृष्ण्यन्धकानामभवदुत्सवो नृपसत्तम॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O best of kings, a few days after a great festival of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas was held on the Raivataka hill.

sa: ईशौ हि तौ महात्मानौ सर्वकार्यप्रवर्तिनौ। धर्मकामार्थलोकानां कार्याणां च प्रवर्तकौ॥
en: The illustrious pair (Krishna and Arjuna) were the masters that directed the every operation of the universe; they directed all acts relating Dharma, Artha and Kama.

sa: सा तु सत्यवती नाम मत्स्यघात्यभिसंश्रयात्। आसीत्सा मत्स्यगन्धैव कंचित्कालं शुचिस्मिता॥
