en: That girl of sweet smiles, was known by the name of Satyavati; but owing to her association with fishermen, she was for years of fishy smell.

sa: भूयश्च चारै राजेन्द्र प्रवृत्तिरुपपादिता। प्रतिज्ञा सूतपुत्रस्य विजयस्य वधं प्रति॥
en: O king of kings, the news had been brought to him by spies that the Suta's son (Karna) had aken the vow to kill Vijaya (Arjuna).

sa: ततोऽपश्यत् सुरम्येषु सुवर्णसिकताचिते॥ देशे समे सुखे चित्रे स्वर्णोद्देशसमे नृप।
en: On his way he saw a very charming and level spot of land covered with golden sands and resembling heaven itself, O king, in its beauty.

sa: विव्याध समरे राजन् कौरवेयान् समन्ततः। वध्यमाना महाराज भीमसेनेन तावकाः॥
en: The son of Kunti pursued that mighty army of your sons from behind and, O king, he began to pierce the Kaurava hosts right and left.

sa: त्यक्त्वा भीमं रणाजग्मुश्चोदयन्तो हयोत्तमान्। तांस्तु निर्जित्य समरे भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: O mighty monarch, your soldiers then thus slaughtered by Bhima, shunning him began to fly away, urging their excellent steeds to the top of their speed.

sa: ऋषिमाङ्गिरसं वृद्धं पुरस्कृत्य तु ते द्विजाः। ददृशुर्ब्रह्मभवने ब्रह्माणं वीतकल्मषम्॥
en: Those twice-born persons, headed by the sage son of Angirasa, proceeded to the region of the Grandfather. There they saw Brahman perfectly purged of all sin.

sa: स पाण्डवानां प्रवरैः सर्वतः समभिद्रुतः। उदीरयन् ब्राह्ममस्त्रं शरैरापूरयद् दिशः॥
en: Thus assailed on all sides by the leading Pandava warriors Karna invoked the assistance of the Brahma weapon and filled all the quarters with his arrows.

sa: तत आहूय वैदेहं मुनिर्वचनमब्रवीत्। अयं राजकुले जातो विदिताभ्यन्तरो मम॥
en: Bhishma said Thereafter, inviting the king of the Videhas, the sage said these words to him,-This person is of royal birth. I know his very heart.

sa: अनुध्यानेन जप्येन विधास्यामः शिवं तव। कथाभिश्चाभिरम्याभिः सह रंस्यामहे वयम्॥
en: And we shall do you good by meditation and prayers and we shall entertain you with pleasant conversation and we shall ourselves be cheered in return.

sa: तस्मात् स्नेहं न लिप्सेत मित्रेभ्योधनसंचयात्। स्वशरीरसमुत्थं च ज्ञानेन विनिवर्तयेत्॥
en: Therefore none should place his attachment on either friends or on wealth which he has carned. The attachment towards one's own body is destroyed by knowledge.

sa: उपप्लेव्य निविष्टोऽपि धर्ममेव युधिष्ठिरः। काक्षते ज्ञातिसौहार्दाद् बलवान् दुर्बलो यथा॥
en: Yudhishthira is staying at Upaplavya like Dharma himself and desires the good will of his kinsmen as the weak desire the good will of the strong.

sa: हा हतास्मि कुतोन्वद्य भवेच्छान्तिरिहानलात्। अनाथा विनशिष्यामि बालकैः पुत्रकैः सह॥
en: Kunti said: Alas, I am undone! How shall we today escape from this fire! Alas, I shall meet with detraction my sons who are but children!

sa: सुखदुःखयोश्च ग्रहणाच्छिन्नस्य च विरोहणात्। जीवं पश्यामि वृक्षाणामचैतन्यं न विद्यते॥
en: They are subject to pleasure and pain, and grow when cut or lopped off. These facts clearly prove that trees have life. They are not manimate.

sa: तथा तु मुदिताः सर्वे पाण्डवा विगतज्वराः। अवसन् पृथिवीपालांस्तापयन्तः स्वतेजसा॥
en: (His brothers) the Pandavas brought by their great powers many kings under their sway; they passed their days in happiness, having nothing to disturb their peace.

sa: रथस्य पुरतो याति यः स चक्रगदाधरः॥ तव स्नेहात् पुराणर्षिर्वासुदेवश्चतुर्भुज।
en: for you He who used to proceed in front of your car, arined with discus and mace, through affection was the four-armed Vasudeva, that ancient Rishi.

sa: एवं बुद्धिश्च तेजश्च प्रतिपत्तिश्च भारता॥ भवन्ति भवकालेषु विपद्यन्ते विपर्यये।
en: Even thus, understanding and prowess and foresight. O Bharata, arise when days of prosperity have gone. These very acquisitions disappear when the hour of adversity comes.

sa: अद्भयोऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्रमश्मनो लोहमुत्थितम्। तेषां सर्वत्रगं तेजः स्वासु योनिषु शाम्यति॥
en: From the waters rose fire, from the Brahmana, the Kshatriya and from stone, the iron. Its strength penetrates everywhere; only in its birth-place is it powerless.

sa: एषा शिवजला पुण्या याति सौम्य महानदी। बदरीप्रभवा राजन् देवर्षिगणसेविता॥
en: O king, here flows the great and beautiful river (Alakananda) of sacred water rising from the Badari tree. It is ever adored by the celestials Rishis,

sa: ततो राजा क्षुच्छ्रमार्तस्तं मुनि स्थाणुवस्थितम्। मौनव्रतधरं शान्तं सद्यो मन्युवशंगतः॥
en: The fatigued and the hungry king grew angry with the Rishi who sat motionless as a piece of wood in observance of his vow of silence.

sa: रेणुकायां यथाऽऽर्चीको हैमवत्यां च कौशिकः। बृहस्पतिश्च तारायां शुक्रश्च शतपर्वणा॥
en: As Jamadagni, the son of Richika with Renuka as the son of Kushika (Vishvamitra) with the princess, Hemavati, as Brihaspati with Tara and Shukra with Shataparva;

sa: एष चेश्यते सम्यक् प्राणिनः सम्यगायतः। असम्यगायतो भूयश्चेष्टते विकृतं नृषु॥
en: When the god does his work properly, he makes all living creatures live at their ease. When, however, he does it improperly, calamities visit the Earth.

sa: मम रोषः समुत्पन्नस्त्वय्येवं सम्प्रभाषति। ब्रवीम्येष स्वयं वायोस्तव दुर्भाषितं बहु॥
en: I am certainly angry with you, for your giving vent to such words. I shall myself communicate to the Windgod all these derogatory words of yours.

sa: सम्प्रयुक्तः किलैवायं दिष्टैर्भवति पूरुषः। तस्मिन्नेव च सर्वार्थाः प्रदृश्यन्ते पृथग्विधाः॥
en: Led by Destiny, man surely engages in any action and it is through the decrees of Destiny that his various acts are attended with various results.

sa: स एव महतीं सेनां समावर्तयदाहवे। किमन्यद् दैवसंयोगान्मम पुत्रस्य चाभवत्॥
en: Even that very Yudhishthira is now leading this mighty host in battle! What else but evil. can befall my son through this adverse influence of Destiny?

sa: तस्य सेनासमूहस्य मध्ये द्रोणः सुरक्षितः। निहतः पार्षतेनाजौ किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: Drona, guarded amidst this host of his warriors, as slain by the son of Prisata in battle; what can it be but there decree of Fate?

sa: तावुभैः समरे शूरौ शरकण्टकिनौ तदः। व्यराजेता महाराज कण्टकैरिव शाल्मलीः॥
en: Then, O great king, both the heroes pierced with shafts (sticking to their bodies) looked beautiful like a couple of Salmali trees (covered) with prickly thorns.

sa: संक्रुद्धः शकुनि षष्ट्या विव्याध भरतर्षभा पुनश्चैनं शतेनैव नाराचानां स्तनान्तरे॥
en: He, (then), O best of the Bharatas, wrathfully pierced Shakuni with six (arrows) and again with a hundred long shafts, in the centre of the chest.

sa: आजघ्ने बहुभिर्वाणैर्जिघांसन्निव भारत। विमुखं तु रणे दृष्ट्वा याज्ञसेनिं महारथम्॥
en: Struck him with numerous arrows, 0 Bharata, (actuated) with the desire of slaying him. Witnessing defeat of that great carwarrior, the son of Jajnasena in battle.

sa: सोऽभिमन्व्य शरं दीप्तं विधूममिव पावकम्। सर्वतः क्रोधमाविश्य चिक्षेप परवीरहा॥
en: That slayer of hostile heroes, filled with extreme raged, let go with due Mantras that shaft that looked resplendent like fire without a curl of smoke.

sa: तोषितोऽहं नृपश्रेष्ठ त्वयेहाद्येन कर्मणा। याजनं ब्राह्मणानां तु विधिदृष्टं परंतप॥
en: "O best of kings, I have been pleased with your (great) act. O chastiser of foes, the duty of assisting at scarifies belongs to the Brahmanas.

sa: दिव्यामृतौ मानसौ द्वौ सुपर्णी वाचा शाखाः पिप्पलाः सप्त गोपाः। दशाप्यन्ये ये पुरं धारयन्ति त्वया सृष्टास्त्वं हि तेभ्यः परोहि॥
en: He who is conversant with the nature of things, thus observing the origin and destruction of all things from you, comprehends your unity and oneness. Two birds (Isvara and Jiva), four Ashvathas with their branches (the Vedas and the auxiliaries), the seven guardians (the five elements and the heart and the understanding).

sa: कृपालुषु परिक्लेशान् पाण्डवीयान् प्रकीर्तयन्। वृद्धेषु कुलधर्मं च ब्रुवन् पूर्वैरनुष्ठितम्॥
en: By detailing those that are kind the hardships of the Pandavas and telling before old people the virtuous acts in the family done by their ancestors,

sa: त्रिगर्ताधिपतेश्चापि भ्रातरं षड्भिराशुगैः। साश्वं ससूतं त्वरितः पार्थः प्रैषीद् यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then with six swift-flying arrows Partha speedily dispatched to the mansion of Death the brother of the ruler of the Trigarttas, with his steeds and charioteers.

sa: राजा च पाण्डवैः सार्धमिष्टे देशे सहानुगः। निवासमकरोद् धीमान् सस्त्रीवृद्धपुरःसरः॥
en: The endued with great intelligence, with the Pandavas, took up his abode in desirable spot, along with the ladies and the aged ones of his household.

sa: तदस्य दृष्ट्वा हृदयमुद्वेगमगमत् परम्॥ अभ्युच्छयश्च रोम्णां वै विक्रियाच परंतप।
en: Seeing the forest, the heart of the Brahmana was greatly agitated. His hairs stood erect, and other signs of fear manifested themselves, O destroyer of enemies.

sa: त्रैलोक्ये यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च। सरिद्वनानि शैलेन्द्रा देवाश्च सपितामहाः॥ नर्मदायां कुरुश्रेष्ठ सह सिद्धर्षिचारणैः। स्नातुमायान्ति पुण्यौघैः सदा वारिषु भारत॥
en: All the Tirthas, sacred spots, rivers, forests and those best of the mountains that are in the three worlds, all the celestials with the Grandsire, with the Siddhas, the Rishis and the Charanas. O foremost of Kurus, O descendant of Bharata, always come to bathe in the sacred waters of the Narmada.

sa: बह्वाश्चर्यं महाराज दृश्यते तत्र पर्वते। पुण्ये स्वर्गोपमे चैव देवर्षिगणसेविते॥
en: O great king, many wonders are to be seen on that sacred mountain which is like heaven itself and which is visited by the celestials Rishis.

sa: ततः शासनमाज्ञाय भ्रातुः प्रियकरं हितम्। गत्वा स प्रविवेशासु सुयज्ञस्य निवेशनम्॥ तं विप्रमग्न्यगारस्थं वन्दित्वा लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत्। सखेऽभ्यागच्छ पश्यत्वं वेश्म दुष्करकारिणः॥
en: Receiving this pleasant and beneficial mandate of his brother, Lakşmaņa speedily went to the abode of Sujajña, and finding thai vipra in the chamber where the sacrificial fire was maintained, worshipped him and addressed him, saying; "friend, come and behold the abode of that one of arduous deeds(Răma) renouncing his incoming installation.”

sa: ततोऽभिविद्धः समरावमर्दी प्रबोधितः सिंह इव प्रसुप्तः। मजिह्मगैः कर्णमियाय जिष्णुः॥
en: Assailed his driver with three arrows and struck down his Flag-staff with three. Thus struck like a sleeping lion awaking, that repressor of enemies in battle,

sa: प्रजज्ञे च ततः काले राजन् राजीवलोचना। कुमारं देवगर्भाभं राजीवनिभलोचनम्॥
en: O king, in due time the lotus-eyed lady (Sharmishtha) gave birth to a son, as effulgent as a celestial child and with eyes like lotus leaves.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं विप्रः सुराणां शैलमभ्यगात्। सोऽभिगम्याब्रवीद् विन्ध्यं सदारः समुपस्थितः॥
en: Lomasha said : Having heard the words of the celestials, the Brahmana went to the mountain. Going there with his wife, he spoke thus to Vindhya.

sa: अपत्यं धर्मफलदं श्रेष्ठं विन्दन्ति मानवाः। आत्मशुक्रादपि पृथे मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: O Pritha, the self created Manu has said that men, failing to obtain son of their own, might raise up excellent virtue giving sons by others.

sa: सर्वा दिशः समचरत् सैन्यं विक्षोभयनिव। बली शूरो महेष्वासो मित्राणामभयंकरः॥
en: That puissant hero, that mighty warrior, that giver of assurances of safety to his friends, traversed in all directions, agitating the host of the enemy. seen

sa: मया तु मोक्षितस्यास्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। अप्रीतिश्च भवेत्कष्टा कीर्तिनाशश्च शाश्वतः॥ तस्मान्मुहूर्त काशिष्ये विक्रम मोक्षितस्य तु। भिन्नं च वानरानीकं तावदाश्वासयाम्यहम्॥
en: Should the relief of the mighty-minded Sugrīva come from me, I should be incurring his displeasure and it would certainly lead to the loss of his reputation for ever; then I must wait a moment and see his own mighty displayed by himself when relieved. Meanwhile let me cheer up the monkey-host.

sa: अथ भ्रातरमव्यग्रं प्रियं रामः प्रियंवदम्। सौमित्रिं तमुवाचेदं ब्रह्मेव त्रिदशेश्वरम्॥
en: Thereupon Rāma spoke to his beloved considerate and fair-speaking brother, the son of Sumitrā, the following pleasant words, like to Brahma addressing the Lord of celestials.

sa: एहि संजय सर्वं मे आचक्ष्वानवशेषतः। सेनानिवेशे यद् वृत्तं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: “Come, O Sanjaya, and tell me everything in detail of the steps taken in the matter of encamping the army of the Kurus and the Pandavas.

sa: सा च बुद्धिमती देवी कालपर्यायवेदिनी॥ गान्धारी सर्वधर्मज्ञा तान्यलीकानि शुश्रुवे।
en: Queen Gandhari, however, who conversant with every duty and endued with great intelligence, and who knew what Time brings on its course, considered them as untrue.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कर्मणा केन स दिवं पुनः प्राप्तो महीपतिः॥६।
en: Janamejaya said : I desire to hear in detail why that king, after entering heaven, was hurled down from it and why he again gained admittance.

sa: नातिचक्राम भीष्मस्य स हि वाक्यमरिंदमः। समुवृत्तो घनापाये वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: That chastiser of foes could not disobey Bhishma's words, as the ocean never goes beyond its shore, though swollen with the waters of the rainy season.

sa: अस्त्राणीच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं यानि देवेषु कानिचित्। ददानीत्येव भगवानब्रवीत् त्र्यम्बकश्च माम्॥
en: I am to have a knowledge of all the weapons presided over by the gods.” Then the god, Traymbaka, said to me" I will give (them).

sa: वनवासगतायाश्च सैन्धवेन दुरात्मना। परामर्शो द्वितीयो वै सोढुमुत्सहते तु का॥
en: Who else except me has so much energy as to suffer the insult offered by the wicked prince of Sindhu during our stay in the forest?

sa: अविस्थलं वृकस्थलं माकन्दी वारणावतम्। अवसानं भवत्वत्र किंचिदेकं च पञ्चमम्॥
en: Give us Avisthala, Vrikasthala, Makandi and Varanavata, with any other village for a fifth and let there be an end of our quarrel over this matter.

sa: अथवा त्वं प्रतिस्तब्धो न निवर्तितुमिच्छसि। तिष्ठ प्राणान्परित्यज्य गमिष्यसि यमक्षयम्॥
en: Or it may be that you are proud; and therefore, have no mind to return. Stay then. Renouncing your life, you shall go to Yama's mansion.

sa: यद्ययं जगतः कर्ता यथैनं मूर्ख मन्यसे। कस्मान्न ब्राह्मणं सम्यगात्मानमवगच्छति॥
en: If this one (Krishna) is the lord of the universe, as this fool thinks himself to be, why does he not then consider himself a Brahmana?

sa: भवन्तु सत्कृतानीह पूर्वमेव प्रचोदितः। ततोऽहं ज्वलमानं वै पायसं प्रत्यवेदयम्॥
en: Indeed, many excellent viands had been kept ready. As soon as I was asked, I caused hot frumenty to be brought and offered to the ascetic.

sa: ततो रेणुः समुद्भूतो विवभौ तस्य वाजिनः॥ अभितो वर्तमानस्य यथोच्चैःश्रवसस्तथा।
en: as The dust raised by the hoofs of that horse as it walked close to Arjuna, looked as beautiful that raised by the celestial horse Uchchaishravas.

sa: सरोषस्त्वथ शार्दूलः श्रुत्वा गोमायुचापलम्॥ बभूवामर्षितो राजा वधं चास्य व्यरोचयत्।
en: Hearing of this unwise act of the jackal, the tiger was insensate with rage. Indeed, the king, yielding to wrath, ordered his minister to be killed.

sa: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः। देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा॥
en: Laksmana, the younger brother of Rama, being thus engaged in penances, having obstructed his breath, Apsarās, Indra and other deities and Rsis showered flowers on him.

sa: आश्वासयेच्चापि परं सान्त्वधर्मार्थवृत्तिभिः। अथास्य प्रहरेत् काले यदा विचलिते पथि॥
en: Securing confidence (of the enemy) by conciliation, by gift of wealth and by long kind behaviour. You must destroy him if he does not walk aright.

sa: तेषां निविशतां तेषु शिबिरेषु महात्मनाम्। नर्दतः सागरस्येव दिवस्पृगभवत् स्वतः॥
en: The sounds which arose from those great kings who lived within those pavilions touched the very heavens and resembled the noise made by the roaring ocean.

sa: संवार्य च रणे द्रोणं कुमारस्तु महाबलः। शरैरनेकसाहौः कृतहस्तो जितश्रमः॥
en: Then that highly puissant and indefatigable Kumara of great lightness of hands, having held Drona at bay in that battle, pierced him with thousands of shafts.

sa: एष रेणुः समुद्भूतो दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठति॥ चक्रनेमिप्रणुन्नेव कम्पते कर्ण मेदिनी।
en: A cloud of dust is overspreading the welkin like a canopy. The whole earth, O Arjuna, is shaking cut deep by the wheels of Arjuna's cars.

sa: पश्यामि त्वां विराजत्वं देवराजमवस्थितम्। श्रीमन्तं द्युतिमन्तं च गर्जमानं ममोपरि॥
en: I now see you blazing with splendour, endued with prosperity, possessed of beauty, placed at the head of all the gods, and thus roaring at me.

sa: यः स्यादनुप्राप्तवधस्तस्यागारं प्रदीपयेत्। अधनान् नास्तिकांश्चौरान विषये स्वे न वासयेत्॥
en: You should burn the house of those that should be killed by you. You should never permit beggars, atheists and thieves to live in you kingdom.

sa: अस्यां हि समितौ राज्ञामेकमप्यजितं युधि। न पश्यामि महीपालं सात्वतीपुत्रतेजसा॥
en: I do not see any king in this assembly of monarchs who has not been defeated by the prowess of this descendant of Satvata race (Krishna).

sa: बिल्वा मार्दङ्गिका आसन् शम्याग्राहा बिभीतकाः। अश्वत्था नर्तकाश्चासन् भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा॥
en: And Vilwas did the office of players of the Mặdanga, and Bibhitakas, that of keepers of Soma, and Asvatthas became dancers, at the energy of Bharadvāja.

sa: इत्येषां निश्चयो ह्यासीत् तत्कालेऽमिततेजसाम्। पुरा परेषां पृथिवी कृतस्नाऽऽसीद् वशवर्तिनी॥
en: Such was the determination, at that time, of these ones of immeasurable prowess. In days of old the earth was under the possession of the enemies.

sa: तथा भीष्मं शान्तनवं भारतानां पितामहम्। शिरसाभिवदेथास्त्वं मम नाम प्रकीर्तयन्॥
en: In the same way should you bow down your head, on my behalf, to the grandsire of the race of Bharata, Bhishma, the son of Shantanu.

sa: भरतस्यान्ववाये हि देवकल्पा महौजसः। बभूवुर्ब्रह्मकल्पाश्च बहवो राजसत्तमाः॥ येषामपरिमेयानि नामधेयानि सर्वशः। तेषां तु ते यथामुख्यं कीर्तयिष्यामि भारत। महाभागान् देवकल्पान् सत्यार्जवपरायणान्॥
en: And in this Bharata race were many godlike and greatly powerful best of monarchs. They were like Brahma himself. Their names are countless. O descendant of the Bharata race, I shall name only the chief ones, who were all blessed with great fortune and devoted to truth and honesty. They were all like the celestial.

sa: पश्यन्ति योगाः सांख्याश्च स्वशास्त्रकृतलक्षणाः। इष्टानिष्टविमुक्तं हि तस्थौ ब्रह्म परात्परम्॥
en: Both Sankhyas and Yogins, according to the teachings of their sciences, consider this universe as the outcome of the action of the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

sa: अद्य तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ लोहिताक्षौ परंतपौ। वासुदेवार्जुनौ कर्ण द्रष्टास्येकरथे स्थतौ॥
en: You will see today, O Karna, stationed on the same car in battle those two foremnost of men with coppery eyes-the subduers of enemies-Krishna and Arjuna.

sa: सिंहनेवादितं वन्यं गजानामाकुलं कुलम्॥ विघम्य राक्षसान् बाणैः साश्वसूतगजान् विभुः।
en: Appeared agitated like a host of wild elephants attacked by a lion. Burning with his arrows the Rakshasas and their horses, charioteer and elephant, O lord.

sa: गौतमोऽपि महातेजा अहल्यासहितः सुखी। रामं सम्पूज्य विधिवत् तपस्तेपे महातपाः॥
en: And the highly energetic Gautama also happy on his union with Ahalyā, honoured Rāma highly, and that one of mighty mortifications then became engaged in austerities.

sa: तांस्तु सर्वान् नरव्याघ्रः सैन्धवान् व्यचरत् बली। अलातचक्रवद् राजशरजालैः समार्पयत्॥
en: The powerful warrior moved a midst that host of enemies with the celerity of a fiery wheel, all the time piercing those warriors with his arrows.

sa: स्वप्नान्ते निशि राजेन्द्र दर्शयामास रश्मिवान्। कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टः पुत्रस्नेहाच्च भारत॥
en: The resplendent god, the sun, O king of kings, moved with great kindness consequent on paternal affection, showed himself, at night, in a dream, O Bharata.

sa: विकर्णं वीक्ष्य निर्भिन्नं तस्यैवान्ये सहोदराः। अभ्यद्रवन्त समरे सौभद्रप्रमुखान् रथान्॥
en: Beholding Vikarna thus penetrated through and through, his other uterine brothers, rushed in that conflict against those warriors who were headed by the son of Subhadra.

sa: स यथानुशशासैनमुतथ्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः। तत् ते सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि निखिलेन युधिष्ठिर॥
en: I shall now, O Yudhishthira, relate to you every thing that Utatthya, that foremost of all perscns conversant with the Vedas, had said to that king.

sa: प्रियार्थं तव पुत्राणां राक्षसं समवाकिरत्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं द्रौणिराक्षसयोर्मधे॥
en: In order to do good to your sons, shrouded the Rakshasa (Ghatotkacha). Then, between the son of Drona and the Rakshas, again took place a battle.

sa: गते सैन्यार्णवं भित्त्वा तरसा पाण्डवर्षभे। संजयैकरथेनैव युयुधाने च मामकम्॥
en: O Sanjaya, on a single car that foremost of the Pandavas viz., Arjuna has gone piercing through my ocean-like host and Yuyudhana also has followed him;

sa: अभ्येत्य कुशलं भद्रे मृदुपूर्वं समाहिता। पृच्छेथाः पुरुषं ह्येनं यथातत्त्वमनिन्दिते॥
en: O gentle one, O blameless one, approaching him and becoming careful, do you ask his welfare; and do you enquire all the particulars about this person.

sa: तस्य कर्णात्मजश्चापं छित्त्वा केतुमपातयत्। तं भ्रातरं परीप्सन्तो द्रौपदेयाः समभ्ययुः॥
en: The son of Karna, in return, sundered his bow and cut down his standard. The sons of Draupadi desiring to rescue their brother, rushed towards him.

sa: यथा ह्येष क्षयो वृत्तो ममापनयसम्भवः। वीराणां तन्ममाचक्ष्व स्थिरीभूतोऽस्मि संजय॥
en: I have now become calm, O Sanjaya; relate to me how this slaughter of heroes is went onslaughter that owes its origin to my evil policy.

sa: संप्रस्रवत्तदा मेदः शोणिते च महाबलः। वध्यमानो नगेन्द्रागैर्भक्षयामास वानरान् ॥
en: And blood and fat flowed copiously down his body; and though struck by the monkeys with peaks of mountains, the mighty one devoured all those monkeys.

sa: यथोक्तवांस्त्वां भगवान् शतक्रतुररिंदम। कृतप्रियस्त्वयास्मीति तस्य ते किं प्रियं कृतम्॥
en: And what good service you rendered to that tormentor of foes the worshipful performer of hundred sacrifices that he said "I have been pleased with you,”

sa: गते त्रयोदशे वर्षे सत्येनायुधमालभे। आनयिष्याम्यहं पार्थान् वशं तव जनाधिप॥
en: O ruler of men, I swear by my weapons that when thirteen years have passed away, I will bring the sons of Pritha under your subjection."

sa: स तेषां प्रेक्षतामेव श्रीमतां दृढधन्विनाम्। ययौ भागीरथीतीरं हरिभि शवेगितैः॥
en: Before the very presence of those illustrious and firm bowmen, Bhima, by means of his very quick-coursing horses, proceeded towards the bank of the river Bhagirathi.

sa: बीजानि ह्यग्निदग्धानि न रोहन्ति पुनर्यथा। ज्ञानदग्धैस्तथा क्लेशैर्नात्मा संयुज्यते पुनः॥
en: As seeds that have been scorched by fire do not produce the plant, so the pains that have been burnt by knowledge cannot affect the soul.

sa: वालिनो मे भयार्तस्य सर्वलोकाभयंकर। ममापि त्वमनाथस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O you, that remove the fear of all creatures, it behove you who am tormented by fear and am helpless, to extend your favour to me.

sa: क्रुद्धस्य भीमसेनस्य मम पुत्रान् जिघांसतः। दुर्योधनहिते युक्ताः समतिष्ठन्त केऽग्रतः॥
en: Who amongst those devoted to the interests of Duryodhana, would withstand Bhimasena in battle, excited as he was with wrath and engaged in slaughtering my sons?

sa: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धो रथात् प्रस्कन्ध स द्विजः। पदातिरुत्पथेनैव प्राद्रवद् दक्षिणामुखः॥
en: At last, filled with an irresistible passion, the Brahmana leaped down from the car, and fled towards the south, running on foot, over a pathless ground.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्य प्रशान्तस्य हविर्ध्वाक्षैः प्रलुप्यते। शार्दूलस्य गुहां शून्यां नीचः क्रोष्टाभिमर्दति॥
en: Alas! the sacrificial ghee of a peaceful Brahmana is being carried away by crows. Alas, the wretched jackal is invading the empty cave of a lion!

sa: आविध्यैतां बदां गुर्वी भीमां काञ्चनमालिनीम्। गिरिप्रकाशान् क्षितिजान् भञ्जयमनिलो यथा॥
en: Whirling that heavy and terrible mace of fierce aspect decked with garlands of gold. Like a violent tempest, I can break down trees resembling huge mountains.

sa: ऐषीकं निहतं दृष्ट्वा कुमारो रावणात्मजः। याम्येनास्त्रेण संकुद्धो योजयामास सायकम्॥ ततस्तदत्रं चिक्षेप लक्ष्मणाय निशाचरः। वायव्येन तदत्रेण निजघान स लक्ष्मणः॥
en: Seeing Aisika baffled, that Prince-son to Rāvana-fired with rage, fixed an arrow on a Yămya' weapon; and then the night-ranger shot that weapon at Lakşmaņa. And Lakşmaņa resisted it by a Vāyavya' weapon. 1. What could this be like? The commentator is silent over this important point. 2. Belonging to the wind-god.

sa: पूजिताश्च ययुर्विप्रा राजानमभिनन्द्य तम्। राजा च हर्षमापेदे पाण्डवः ससुहृज्जनः॥
en: Duly adored the Brahmanas went away, having pleased the king with their blessing. The royal son of Pandu also, with all his friends, became highly happy.

sa: बृहद्रथस्य प्रणिधिः काश्यपस्य महत्तरः। भानुरङ्गिरसो धीरः पुत्रो वर्चस्य सौभरः॥
en: Of these Pranidhi was the son of Brihadratha, Mahattara the son of Kashyapa, Bhanu was the grand son of Chyavana and Saubhara, the son of Varcha.

sa: अनभ्रे महाघोरः स्तनितः श्रूयते स्वनः। वाहनानां च रुदतां निपतन्त्यश्रुबिन्दवः॥
en: Even when the sky is cloudless, even then fearful roars are heard there. The animals are all weeping and tears are falling fast from their eyes.

sa: घटोत्कचने क्रुद्धेन गदा हेमाङ्गदा तदा॥ क्षिप्ताऽऽभ्राम्य शरैः सापि कर्णेनाभ्याहतापतत्।
en: Thereafter a gold-decked mace was whirled and hurled at Karna by Ghatotkacha. But the former cutting it off with his arrows felled it on the ground.

sa: दश नागसहस्राणि हयानां हेममालिनाम्। यं यान्तमनुयान्तीह सोऽयं द्यूतेन जीवति॥
en: It is he, who while going out, was followed by ten thousand elephants, adorned with golden garlands, and he now supports himself by gambling at dice.

sa: कृच्छ्रेण च समाश्वस्ताः संगम्य च ततस्ततः। वृक्षाद्रिहस्ता हरयस्तस्थुः संग्राममूर्धनि।।।।
en: Then cheered up with much ado, the monkeys meeting together, and taking trees and rocks in their hands, stood their ground in the van of battle.

sa: पाण्डवा अपि तत् सर्वं प्रतिचक्रुर्यथागतम्। उद्भावनमकुर्वन्तो विदुरस्य मते स्थिताः॥
en: The Pandavas, however, counteracted them one after the other as they were made and in obedience to the counsel of Vidura, they never talked it afterwards.

sa: स्वास्थ्यं भद्रं भजस्वार्य त्यज्यतां कृपणा मतिः। अर्थो हि नष्टकार्या१रयत्नेनाधिगम्यते॥
en: Do you, console yourself and renounce your poorliness of mind, O worshipful one. Without sufficient endeavours even men of energy do not regain their lost ends.

sa: धैर्यं त्यक्त्वा महीपाल दारुणे युगसंक्षये। विकर्माणि करिष्यन्ति शूद्राणां परिचारकाः॥
en: O ruler of earth, they will lose all patience in this fearful age. They will do all improper works and become the servants of the Shudras.

sa: एतेन विधिना छन्नः कृतकेन यथानलः। विहरिष्यामि राजेन्द्र विराटभवने सुखम्॥
en: O great king, hiding myself by this counterfeiting means as fire is concealed by ashes, I shall happily pass my days in the palace of Virata.

sa: सावित्र्या प्रीतया दत्ता सावित्र्या हुत्या ह्यपि। सावित्रीत्येव नामास्याश्चक्रुर्विप्रास्तथा पिता॥
en: And as Savitri gladly gave (him) that daughter on account of the king (daily) offering her oblations, both her father and the Brahmanas named her Savitri.

sa: समेत्य समहेन्द्राश्च भयान्मन्त्रं प्रचक्रिरे। शरण्यं शरणं देवं नारायणमजं विभुम्॥
en: Assembling all together with Indra in their midst, they consulted with one another out of fcar. They asked protection from the increate and exalted deity, Narayana.

sa: दुर्योधनसमो नास्ति गदायामिति निश्चयः। संकर्षणस्य भद्रं ते यत् तदैनमुपावसम्॥
en: In a fight with the mace there is none equal to Duryodhana-this is sure; for he used to live with Sankarshana (his preceptor), good betide you.

sa: युध्यमाना हि कौरव्याः कृन्तमानाः परस्परम्। निहताः सहिताश्चान्यैस्तच नास्त्यप्रियं मम॥
en: While engaged in battle. the Kauravas, puffed up with arrogance and pride have perished with many others who helped them. I am not grieved at this.

sa: आरोहे पर्यवस्कन्दे सरणे सान्तरप्लुते। सम्यक्प्रहरणे याने व्यपयाने च कोविदम्॥
en: They are experts in mountain upon and descending from vehicles, in moving forward and in falling back, in striking down effectually and in advancing and retreating.

sa: अद्वारेण प्रविष्टेन छद्मना ब्रह्मवादिना। दृष्टः प्रभावः कृष्णेन जरासंधस्य भूपतेः॥
en: Entering (the city) by a way which was not the (public) gate, and disguised as a Vedaknowing (Brahmana), this Krishna saw the prowess of king Jarasandha.

sa: हतस्य नरकस्यात्मा कर्णमूर्तिमुपाश्रितः। तद् वैरं संस्मरन् वीर योत्स्यते केशवार्जुनौ॥
en: The soul of the killed Naraka has assumed the form of Karna. Recollecting. O hero, his former enmity, he will kill both Keshava (Krishna) and Arjuna.

sa: शिखण्डिनं षड्भिरविध्यदुग्रो धार्टद्युम्नेः स शिरश्चोचकर्त। तथाभिनत् सुतसोमं शरेण सुसंशितेनाधिरथिर्महात्मा॥
en: With six other powerful arrows hit Shikhandi himself and killed Dhristadyumna's son; and the noble son of Adhiratha also struck Sutasoma with a very sharp arrows.

sa: एकैकमेते राजेन्द्र मनुष्यान् पर्युपासते। यैराविष्टो नरः पापं मूढसंज्ञो व्यवस्यति॥
en: Each of this, O chief among kings, awaits (opportunity for getting into its clutches) mankind. Man affected with them loses his senses and does sinful acts.

sa: ततः पुनरथोवाच ज्ञापकं पूर्वचोदितम्। युधिष्ठिर निबोधेदं संज्ञार्थं वचनं कवेः॥
en: He said these word to show that he was really sent (by Vidura). (He said), "O Yudhishthira, listen to what the learned Vidura) said to you.

sa: ददर्शोष्णोदकैः पूर्णा नदीं चापि सुदुर्गमाम्। असिपत्रवनं चैव निशितं क्षुरसंवृतम्॥
en: He saw a river full of boiling water and therefore difficult to cross as also a forest of trees whose leaves were sharp swords and razors.

sa: ते द्रोणपुत्रमासाद्य यथावृत्तं न्यवेदयन्॥ व्यवहारं गदायुद्धे पार्थिवस्य च पातनम्।
en: Repairing to Drona's son, the messengers communicated to him all that had taken place regarding the conduct of the mace-fight and the fall of the king.

sa: अहंकारं बलं दर्प कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः। मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः॥
en: These men, the servitors, being full of vanity, power, pride, lust and wrath, hate Me in their own bodies as well as in those of others.

sa: इतोऽप्यधर्मेण हतो भीष्मः परपुरंजयः॥ भूरिश्रवा ह्यधर्मेण त्वया धर्मविदा हतः।
en: Now for the Pandavas, the grand-father of the Kurus, Bhishma was slain by an act of unrighteousness. Bhurisrava was unfairly slain by your very justicel-oving self.

sa: अथावधश्च शूत्रणामधर्मः श्रूयतेऽर्जुन। क्षत्रियस्य हि धर्मोऽयं हन्याद्धन्येत वा पुनः॥
en: It has been heard, O Arjuna, that, without slaying one's enemies one incurs sin. The duty of a Kshatriya is to stay or to be slain.

sa: तेषां समिध्य तानग्नीन् मन्त्रवच्च जुहाव सः। समृद्धिवृद्धिलाभाय पृथिवीविजयाय च॥
en: Lighting up fires, he offered with Mantras the oblations on them that they might gain prosperity and success and spread their conquest all over the earth.

sa: नियच्छन्नितरान् वर्णान् विनिघ्नन् सर्वदुष्कृतः। ससहायोऽसहायो वा यावज्जीवं तथा भवेत्॥
en: Ruling ever all the other orders and slaying all evil doers he should live though out his life, whether he be with support or without it,

sa: एवं ये ज्ञातयोऽर्थेषु मिथो गच्छन्ति विग्रहम्। तेऽमित्रवशमायान्ति शकुनाविव विग्रहात्॥
en: In the same way those cousins who quarrel in matters of wealth are brought under the control of enemies like the birds owing to their quarrel.

sa: निरमपेष्वचेष्टेषु प्रेक्षमाणेषु पाण्डुषु। पाहि मामिति गोविन्द मनसा चिन्तितोऽसि मे॥
en: The sons of Pandu, gazing at me, without any wrath and without any efforts to extricate me, O Govinda, were thought of by me, saying-"save me."

sa: तथा तु बहुधा कन्यामुक्तवन्तं नराधिपम्। उशीनरं द्विजश्रेष्ठो गालवः प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: The best among the twice-born, Galava then worshipped the king of men, who spoke in that strain many other things by bestowing upon him that maiden.

sa: ऋजु पश्यति यः सर्वं चक्षुषानुपिबन्निव। आसीनमपि तूष्णीकमनुरज्यन्ति तं प्रजाः॥
en: He (the king) who looks affectionately, as if drinking with his eyes, on all, though only sitting without any exertion-can inspire affection in all his subjects.

sa: पुत्र उवाच अकोशस्यासहायस्य कुतः सिद्धिर्जयो मम। इत्यवस्थां विदित्वैतामात्मनाऽऽत्मनि दारुणाम्॥
en: The son said Having no wealth, having no friends, how can I gain success and victory. Knowing these circumstances I have thus dealt harshly with myself.

sa: अधः पादतलेनैतानधिष्ठास्यामि भूतले। न हि त्वं नाभिजानासि मम विक्रममच्युत॥
en: I shall fell them down to the earth and trample them with the soles of my feet. You, O Acchyuta, are not unfamiliar with my strength.

sa: कुण्डलाभ्यां विमुक्तोऽहं वर्मणा सहजेन च। गमनीयो भविष्यामि शत्रूणां द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Divested of my ear-rings and the armour with which I was born, Obest of the Brahmanas, I shall be liable to be killed by my enemies.

sa: तस्य सैन्यमतीवासीत् तस्मिन् बलसमागमे। प्रेक्षणीयतरं राजन् सुवेषं बलवत् तदा॥
en: And all his troops being assembled, the army with its fine dress and which was very strong became an object worth seeing, O chief among kings.

sa: संसक्तो हर्म्यशिखरात् तस्मात् पुनरवापतत्। लवयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां सुवेलस्य समीपतः॥
en: And he again took a leap from the roof of the palace whereon he descended and clearing the city of Lanka, come down to his comrades.

sa: यस्मा मम सपुत्रायास्त्वं नाथो मधुसूदन। रामश्च बलिनां श्रेष्ठः प्रद्युम्नश्च महारथः॥ साऽहमेवंविधं दुःखं सहेऽद्य पुरुषोत्तम। भीमे जीवति दुर्धर्षे विजये चापलायिनि॥
en: Having yourself, O slayer of Madhu, as the protector of myself with my sons and as also that foremost of powerful men, Rama and that great car-warrior Pradyumna; and having the invincible Bhima and Vijaya who never turn back from the field alive, that I should suffer this sort of grief, O best among men!

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच अहं सैरन्ध्रवेषेण चरन्ती राजवेश्मनि। शौचदास्मि सुदेष्णाया अक्षधूर्तस्य कारणात्॥
en: Draupadi said Alas, on account of that one skilled in gambling I am under Sudeshna's command, dwelling in the palace in the guise of a Sairandhri.

sa: आश्रमेषु चतुर्बाहुर्दममेवोत्तमं व्रतम्। तस्य लिङ्गं प्रवक्ष्यामि येषां समुदयो दमः॥
en: For all the four stages of life, self-control is a very good vow; I speak of the characteristics of him whose life is one of self-control.

sa: योऽयं तपःप्रभावेण ऋषिसंतोषणेन च। दिव्यः पुरुष उत्पन्नो ज्वालावर्णो महाभुजः॥
en: He, who by the virtue of his austerity and by his gratification of the Rishis, that celestial being of long arms came out, looking like fire,

sa: सोमः प्रजापतिः पूर्व कुरूणां वंशवर्धनः। सोमाद् बभूव षष्ठोऽयं ययातिनहुधात्मजः॥
en: That lord of creatures, Soma was the first who begot the race of Kurus, and sixth in descent from Soma was Yayati the son of Nahusa.

sa: तन्तवोऽs: प्यायिता नित्यं तनवो बहुलाः समाः। बहून् बहुत्वादायासान् सहन्तीत्युपमासताम्॥
en: Several thin threads of the same length collected together can bear the weight of the shuttle-cock constantly passing over them easily owing to their numerical strength.

sa: सम्प्राप्य हास्तिनपुरं शीघ्रमेव प्रविश्य च। अन्तःपुरं समास्थाय द्वा:स्थं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having reached Hastinapura, he entered it quickly and standing at the gate (entrance of the) inner apartments of the palace said these words to the gate-keeper.

sa: इमां हि पत्नीमस्माकं धर्मज्ञां धर्मचारिणीम्। संस्पृशेदीदृशो भावः शुचिं स्तैन्यमिवानृतम्॥
en: How could (such a misfortune) overcome such a pious, chaste wife of ours, abiding by virtue, like a false accusation of theft against an honest man?

sa: यदि भीमार्जुनौ कृष्ण धर्मराजश्च धार्मिकः। धर्ममुत्सृज्य तेनाहं योद्भुमिच्छामि संयुगे॥
en: If Bhima and Arjuna, O Krishna and the virtuous king are virtuous, then I leading the path of virtue desire to fight with him in battle.

sa: द्वादशेमानि वर्षाणि वने निर्युषितानि नः। त्रयोदशं तथाऽज्ञातैः सजने परिवत्सरम्॥
en: These twelve years have been spent by us in exile in the forest and the thirteenth year have we spent in each other's company in disguise.

sa: एकेनास्य धनुष्मन्तं बाहुं देहादपातयत्। द्वितीयेन सनाराचं भुजं भूमौ न्यपातयत्॥ तृतीयेन तु बाणेन पृथुधारेण भास्वता। जहार सुनसं चापि शिरो भ्राजिष्णुकुण्डलम्॥
en: By one of these (arrows), he severed from his body that arm which wielded the bow; by the second, he cut down to the ground that arm which wielded the arrows and by the third arrow of keen edge and bright lustre he cut off his head having a beautiful nose and decked with earrings.

sa: त्वं धर्ममर्थं संजानन् सम्यड्नस्त्रातुमर्हसि। गुरुत्वं भवति प्रेक्ष्य बहून् क्लेशांस्तितिक्ष्महे॥
en: Knowing the principles of virtue and worldly good, it is your duty to save us; seeing that you are our elder, have we patiently suffered troubles.

sa: मितं भुङ्क्ते संविभज्याश्रितेभ्यो मितं स्वपित्यमितं कर्म कृत्वा। स्तमात्मवन्तं प्रजहत्यनाः॥
en: One who eats with moderation after doing excessive work, who gives away, (even) to foes when asked, is never beside himself; and evils always avoid him.

sa: ह्रियमाणा तु सा राजन् सूतपुत्रैरनिन्दिता। प्राक्रोशन्नाथमिच्छन्ती कृष्णा नाथवती सती॥
en: Being thus carried away by the sons of Suta, O king, the faultless fertured and chaste Krishna, having lord, bewailed for the help of her husbands.

sa: अनित्यं किल मर्त्यस्य पार्थ चित्तं चलाचलम्। वातवेगप्रचलिता अष्ठीला शाल्मलेरिव॥
en: O son of Pritha, the hearts of earthly men are inconstant and susceptible of change like a young Shalmali tree moved by the force of wind.

sa: सूतपुत्रस्तु मां दृष्ट्वा महत् सान्त्वमवर्तयत्। सान्त्वे प्रतिहते क्रुद्धः परामर्शमनाभवत्।॥
en: Beholding me, the Suta's son began to court me in sweet words; when his court failed, he became enraged and attempted to use violence on me.

sa: यं श्रुत्वायं मनुष्येन्द्रः सर्वदुःखातिगो भवेत्। लाभालाभौ प्रियद्वेष्यौ यथैनं न जरान्तकौ॥ विषहेरन् भयामर्षी क्षुत्पिपासे मदोद्भवौ। अरतिश्चैव तन्द्री च कामक्रोधौ क्षयोदयौ॥
en: Hearing which (your speech) this chief among men will be past all misery; so that gain and the reverse of gain, what is agreeable and disagreeable, old age and death, fear and jealously, hunger and thirst, pride and prosperity, disinclination for women, sleep, desire, anger, loss and gain may be borne by him (with ease).

sa: मांसशोणितवर्षं च वृष्टं देवेन माधव। तथा गन्धर्वनगरं भानुमत् समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Down pours of flesh and blood are poured by the gods, O Madhava, and the city of Gandharvas appears shining like the sun in the sky,

sa: अभिवादयन्ति भवर्ती पाण्डवाः सह कृष्णया। आत्मानं च कुशलिनं निवेद्याहुरनामयम्॥
en: The son of Pandu along with Krishna send their greetings to you; and having submitted to your notice that they are in health, asked about welfare.

sa: एक पक्षाक्षिचरणाः पक्षिणो मधुसूदन। उत्सृजन्ति महद् घोरं तत् पराभवलक्षणम्॥
en: Birds, having but one wing, or one eye or one leg, O slayer of Madhu, make terrific shrieks and these are the signs of a defeat.

sa: त्यक्तग्राम्यसुखाः पार्था नित्यं वीरसुखप्रियाः। न तु स्वल्पेन तुष्येयुर्महोत्साहा महाबलाः॥
en: The Partha's ever desirous of enjoyment of heroes' life forego mean happiness; those men of great energy and great prowess were not content with a little.

sa: कोशसंवनने दाने भृत्यानां चान्ववेक्षणे। भरणे चैव सर्वस्य विदुरः सत्यसङ्गरः॥
en: The one, ever devoted to truth namely Vidura, took charge of treasury, gifts and presents and the supervision over the subordinates and the feeding of all.

sa: भृत्याः पुरोहिताचार्या ब्राह्मणाश्च बहुश्रुताः। मामूचु शसंतप्ता भव राजेति संततम्॥
en: My servants, my priests, my preceptors and other Brahmanas well versed in holy books said to me, being struck with great sorrow "Yourself be the king.

sa: इदं मे महादाश्चर्यं पर्वतस्येव सर्पणम्। यदीदृशं प्रभाषेथा भीमसेनासमं वचः॥
en: It is to me as great a wonder as the lifting up of a mountain that you should speak worlds in this strain so unlike Bhimasena.

sa: समाधायायुधं शम्यां गच्छामो नगरं प्रति। एवमत्र यथायोगं विहरिष्याम भारत॥
en: Having thus deposited our weapons on the Shami tree we shall, O Bharata, go to the city and pass our days there in style befitting us.

sa: सर्वेषामेव भवतां संतापो मा भवेदिति। अतो विरात्रागमनं नान्यदस्तीह कारणम्॥
en: Considering that you all should not be troubled on my account, I came so late at night. There is no other reason (for my late arrival).

sa: हृष्टरूपा महात्मानो निवासाय महीक्षिताम्। ततस्ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे तच्छ्रुत्वा राजशासनम्॥
en: Then did those rulers of the earth hearing those commands of the king become cheerful and made the necessary arrangements for the residence of the allies.

sa: क्षुद्राक्षेणेव जालेन झपावपिहितावुरू। कामश्च राजन् क्रोधश्च तौ प्रज्ञानं विलुम्पतः॥
en: In the same way, as a big fish breaks through a net of thin chords, so, O king, desire and anger cast wisdom in the shade.

sa: प्रभाते लक्ष्मणं वीरमभ्यभाषत दुर्मनाः। सीतां संस्मृत्य धर्मात्मा रुद्धां राक्षसवेश्मनि॥
en: Afflicted at the thoughts of Sita confined in the abode of the Rakshasha (Ravana), the virtuous (Rama) thus addressed the war-like Lakshmana in the (next) morning.

sa: पतनारोहणमिदं कथयिष्यन्ति ये नराः। विषमाण्यपि ते प्राप्तास्तरिष्यन्ति न संशयः॥
en: Those men, who will converse on this story of your fall and recession, will attain salvation though affected by sins; there is no doubt of it.

sa: आविशद्भिस्तदा राजन्शूरैः परिघबाहुभिः॥ शुशुभे सा सभा राजन् सिंहैरिव गिरेर्गुहा।
en: At the time, O king, filled with those heroes, having arms like iron maces, that Council Chamber, O king, appeared like a den filled with lion.

sa: शिवाश्च विनदन्त्येता दीप्तायां दिशि दारुणाः। हयाश्चाश्रूणि मुञ्चन्ति ध्वजाः कम्पन्त्यकम्पिताः॥
en: Frightened by the conflagration on all sides the jackals are yelling hideously, the horses are shedding tears and flags are being shaken although moved by none.

sa: तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा देवैः शक्रपुरोगमैः॥ कौसल्यामातरिष्टांस्ते वरानद्य ददानि कान्।
en: Then Brahma together with (all) the celestials headed by Shakra said to him, “O son of Kausalya, what desirable boons shall we bestow on you today"?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु कौरवेयेषु भारत। उपायादर्जुनस्तूर्णं रथघोषेण नादयन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the mighty car-warriors of the Kurus had arrayed themselves in battle, sending out the rattle of their chariots, he quickly proceeded towards them.

sa: दुपदो मत्स्यराजश्च संक्रुद्धश्च धनंजयः। न शेषयेयुः समरे वायुयुक्ता इवाग्नयः॥
en: Drupada, the king of the Matsyas and Dhananjaya, fired with wrath, will leave no trace (of your army) like a conflagration urged on by the wind.

sa: अनृते च समुत्कर्षो राजगामि च पैशुनम्। गुरोचालीकनिर्बन्धः समानि ब्रह्महत्यया॥
en: A victory gained by untruth, a deceit that reaches (in its injurious effects) a king and the expression of false intentions before an elder na. are

sa: नातः पापीयसीं कांचिदवस्थां शम्बरोऽब्रवीत्। यत्र नैवाद्य न प्रातर्भोजनं प्रतिदृश्यते॥
en: There is no condition more frightful than this, said Shamvara, namely that in which the food for today and that for the morrow are not seen.

sa: अवृत्तिर्भयमन्त्यानां मध्यानां मरणाद् भयम्। उत्तमानां तु मानामवमानात् परं भयम्॥
en: Loss of livelihood is feared by men of the lower classes; death is feared by the middle classes and insult is greatly feared by good men.

sa: जानन्ति कुरवः सर्वे यथोक्ताः कुरुसंसदि। दुःशासनेन कौन्तेयाः प्रव्रजन्तः परंतपाः॥
en: All the Kurus know how in the assembly those chastisers of foes, the sons of Kunti, were on the eve of their exile, addressed by Dushasana.

sa: स भिन्नहृदयो वीरो वक्त्राच्छोणितमुद्वमन्। पपाताभिमुखः पार्थं छिन्नमूल इव दुमः॥
en: Thus struck on the breast that hero began to vomit blood and fell down on earth like an uprooted tree by the side of Pritha's son.

sa: क्षपयिष्यति नो राजन् कालचक्रमिवोद्यतम्। तस्याद्य वसुधा राजन् निखिला भरतर्षभ॥
en: Will overthrow us, O king, like the uplifted wheel of death. To-day, the entire earth is his, O king, O bull of the race of Bharata.

sa: पर्जन्यनाथाः पशवो राजानो मन्त्रिवान्धवाः। पतयो बान्धवाः स्त्रीणां ब्राह्मणा वेदबान्धवाः॥
en: Creatures depend on clouds; kings have the counsellors for their friends; husbands are the friends of women and the Brahmanas have the Vedas for their friends.

sa: दूरादेव तु तां प्रेक्ष्य राजपुत्रोऽभ्यभाषत। त्वया सारथिना पार्थः खाण्डवेऽग्निमतर्पयत॥
en: Having got you as his charioteer, Kunti's son Partha, the conqueror of the god of riches, offered oblation to Khandava fire and completely subjugated the world.

sa: भीमसेनं च संक्रुद्धं यमौ चापि यमोपमौ। युयुधानद्वितीयं च धृष्टद्युम्नममर्षणम्॥
en: As also when he sees Bhimasena excited with anger, and the twins who are like Yama himself and the wrathful Dhrishtadyumna having Yuyudhana for his second,

sa: तत: प्रयाते दाशार्ह कुरवः संगता मिथः। जजल्पुर्महदाश्चर्यं केशवे परमाद्भुतम्॥
en: The scion of the Dasharha race having departed, the Kurus assembled together and conversed on the greatly wonderful thing which had happened in connection with Krishna.

sa: आयोधितास्तु गन्धर्वाः सुचिरं सोदरैर्मम। मया सह महाबाहो कृतश्चोभयतः क्षयः॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, for a long time my brothers standing by me fought with the Gandharvas. But the slaughter on both the sides was very great.

sa: अनसूयुः कृतप्रज्ञः शोभनान्याचरन् सदा। नकृच्छ्रे महदाप्नोति सर्वत्र च विरोचते॥
en: He that is not envious and he who is wise by always doing graceful acts, never meets with any grave difficulties; and shines with luster everywhere.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच नायं पापसमाचारो मत्तो जीवितुमर्हति। कृष्णायास्तदनस्याः परिक्लेष्टा नराधमः॥
en: Bhima said: “This vilest and foolish man has done a great injury to Krishna who does not deserve it; so he does not deserve to live.

sa: तस्या दृष्टिरभूद् दिव्या सापश्यद् दिव्यदर्शनम्। आमुक्तकवचं देवं कुण्डलाभ्यां विभूषितम्॥
en: She was, then, all on a sudden gifted with celestials sight. And she perceived the deity of divine form clad in armour and decked with ear-rings.

sa: नावो न सन्ति सेनाया बयस्तारयितुं तथा। वणिजामुपघातं च कथमस्मद्विधश्चरेत्॥
en: (Moreover), there are not plenty of boats of land our troops. Again (the interests of) trade should not suffer at the hands of men like us.

sa: राजकिल्बिषिणां तेषां भर्तृपिण्डापहारिणाम्। नैवायं न परो लोको विद्यते पापकर्मणाम्॥
en: Untrue to the bread of their lord, as they are, these faithless servants of their kings have neither this world nor the next for their good.

sa: यदेकः सहितान् सर्वान् रणेऽयुध्यत पाण्डवान्॥ ततोऽपश्यन्महात्मा स स्वसैन्यं भृशदुःखितम्।
en: Duryodhana then saw that all his soldiers were assailed with wounds and about to flee but had not gone very far from the scene of action.

sa: परिव्रजन्ति दानार्थं मुण्डाः काषायवाससः। सिता बहुविधै पाशैः संचिन्वन्तो वृथामिषम्॥
en: Having shaved their heads clean and put on the brown robe, people rove like mendicants, though fettered by various ties and though always seeking useless wealth.

sa: तमूचुः सम्प्रयास्यन्तं शैव्यसुग्रीववाहनम्॥ प्रत्याश्वासय गान्धारी हतपुत्रां यशस्विनीम्। स प्रायात् पाण्डवैरुक्तस्तत् पुरं सात्वतां वरः॥ आससाद ततः क्षिप्रं गान्धारीं निहतात्मजाम्॥
en: While about to start on his car, having Shaivya and Sugriva yoked to it, (the Pandavas) said to him—Comfort the helpless Gandhari who has lost all her sons.'-Thus addressed by the Pandavas, the chief of the Satvatas then set out for Hastinapura and arrived before Gandhari who had all her sons slain.”

sa: धर्माणामविरोधेन सर्वेषां प्रियमाचरेत्। ममायमिति राजा यः स पर्वत इवाचलः॥
en: The king should do good to all persons without violating the injunctions of Righteousness. That king stands firm as a rock whom everybody regards-He is mine.

sa: सद्भिराचरितं पूर्वं यथावदनुयायिनम्। अपृच्छद् वसुहोमस्तं राजन् किं करवाणि ते॥
en: After this, Vasuhoma addressed his royal guest who strictly followed the conduct of the righteous men of old, saying,-What, О king, shall I do for you.

sa: तथैव तपसोपेताः स्वाध्यायाभ्यसने रताः। दातारो यज्ञशीलाश्च न तरन्ति जरान्तकौ॥
en: Likewise, persons endued with ascetic merit, devoted to study of the Vedas, practising charity and frequently celebrating sacrifices. cannot escape the hands of decrepitude and death.

sa: भीम उवाच श्रोत्रियस्येव ते राजन् मन्दकस्याविपश्चितः। अनुवाकहता बुद्धि:षा तत्त्वार्थदर्शिनी॥
en: Bhimasena said-Your understanding, O king, cannot perceive the truth, like that of a foolish and unintelligent reciter of the Veda for his recitation of those scriptures.

sa: यतः सर्वं प्रसूयन्ते ह्यनङ्गात्माङ्गदेहिनः। उन्मादः सर्वभूतानां तस्मै कामात्मने नमः॥
en: From you have originated all things. You move all creatures having physical frames and cherishing desires to action. Salutations to thee in your form of Excitement.

sa: अमर्षी दीर्घरोषश्च महेष्वासो महाबलः। रणे विनिहतः शेते शूरो गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
en: Wrathful and energetic, he was a great bowman and a powerful car-warrior. Killed in battle by holder of Gandiva, that hero now sleeps on the ground.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमा गाथा गीता ययातिना। याभिः प्रत्याहरेत् कामान् कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः॥
en: Regarding it is cited the discourse of Yayati. Listening to that discourse one can withdraw all his desires like a tortoise drawing in all his limbs.
